prakrit: अन्नं च पञ्चसरलोद्धएणं महुमासबिइज्जएण दयरहियं,हम्मन्तीओ गाढं दट्ठूणव पहियमहिलाओ
english: Food and drink should be given to the fivefolded lotus flower, For it is the wife who gives milk to the sage.

prakrit: हसियंव मज्झसण्ठियकलयण्ठिकएण कूइयरवेण,पयडियमञ्जरिगुरुदन्तपन्तियं चूयविडवेहिं
english: Laughing at the gooseflesh hovering over my waist, Payyadeemanjari gurudantepantiyum chuyvideweyhim.

prakrit: दट्ठूण पहियनिवहं निहयं महुमासलोद्धयनरेण,ओणयमुहीओ कुसुमंसुएहिं रोयन्तिव लयाओ
english: Look at that lovely woman Whose face is smeared with bees, Crying with the fragrance of kisses.

prakrit: मयपहियाण जलन्तिव ठाणे ठाणे महन्तचीयाओ,घणकिंसुयच्छलेणं अलिरवमिसिमिसियसद्दाओ
english: Maypahyan Jalantiv Thane Mahantachiyao, Ghanakinke Suyachalan Alirvamisimiciousadhao

prakrit: निज्झरतडेसु तरुणो पवणपहल्लन्तजलनिबुड्डेहिं,साहाकरेहिं देन्तिव जलञ्जलिं जत्थ पहियाणं
english: In the spring the young man steps in front of a cascade of rippling water, Helping the traveler carry the torrent with him.

prakrit: किञ्च घणकिंसुयनवरङ्गयविराइया बद्धपवरमयणहला,पाडलकुसुमा सोहई वसन्तलच्छी नववहुव्व
english: Some lovely girl, Pretending to be pregnant With a fresh pair of bangles, Lovely girl, Spring is on the horizon, So is the new bride.

prakrit: अन्नं च बुहसहिओवि हु सूरो कव्वसत्तो वसन्तमाहप्पा,उवभुञ्जिऊण मीणं सम्पइ मेसस्स उक्कॊत्ति
english: There's a lot of sunshine And the moon looks like a lotus, But when you touch it with your finger It wipes away the whole mess.

prakrit: ता एरिसे वसन्ते दिसिदिसिपसरन्तपरहुयासद्दे,वित्थरियचच्चरीरवमुहरियउज्जाणभूभागे
english: There is a spring in the sky, Running from day to day, Like the earth churning with the rays of the sun.

prakrit: विलसन्ति कामुयजणा अन्दोलिज्जन्ति तरुणजुवईओ,वित्थरइ पडहयरवो पियन्ति वरवारुणिं तरुणा
english: Delighted are the young men who yearn for pleasure, And the young women who grovel for pleasure.

prakrit: साहीणपिययमाणं तरुणीणं वल्लहम्मि महुमासे,धम्मपरायणलोएण एत्थ कीरन्ति जत्ताओ
english: A swarm of bees is at hand, Like a young bridegroom At the time of her wedding. So gather the creepers here, Like people who follow the dharma.

prakrit: जिणबिम्बाणं भत्तीए तेण एए समागया देवा,सव्वायरेण वेयड्ढसिद्धकूडेसु जत्तत्थं
english: As long as you worship him, O God of Love, May he guide you all the way.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं जइ एवं तो वयंस! अम्हेवि,गन्तूण सिद्धकूडे सासयसव्वन्नुपडिमाओ
english: Well, my brother - in - law will come, and so will we! My dear, There must be a way.

prakrit: भत्तीए पणमिऊणं करेसु नियमाणुसत्तणं सहलं,पेच्छामो जिणजत्तं सुयखयरोहेण किज्जन्तं
english: I will put up with it, my dear, As long as I abide by the rules Of etiquette. But how can I live a happy life If I refuse to bow down?

prakrit: अह सव्वेहिवि भणियं एवं होउत्ति सुट्ठु ते भणियं,एत्थन्तरम्मि पत्तो मह धाइसुओ बलो नाम
english: Oh! everyone! My brother - in - law and wife are sleeping soundly. Tell me, my poor girl, The path from here to there.

prakrit: आगम्म तेम भणियं पिउणा ते चित्तवेग! संलत्तं,एसो हु रयणसञ्चयवत्थव्वो सयलखयरजणो
english: Come, let us eat and drink together, That is the way of mind!"" ""Here I am,"" ""says the wise man,"" Steady as a log.

prakrit: न्हाओ विलित्तदेहो सुहनेवत्थो महाविभूईए,चलिओ जिणजत्ताए आसन्ने सिद्धकूडम्मि
english: Be not dismayed: With pleasure and glory be yours; For the victory is sure to come At the right time.

prakrit: तेण समं अम्हेवि हु चलिया ता सिग्घमेव आगच्छ,कयण्हाणाइविहाणा जेण समं चेव गच्छामो
english: As fast as we walk, So slowly do we come; As slow as a bridegroom's pace, So fast do we go.

prakrit: तव्वयणं सोऊणं नियगेहे आगओ पिउसमीवे,तेवि य मज्झ वयंसा नियनियगेहेसु सम्पत्ता
english: If you want to sleep peacefully At the same time as your husband, You have to live peacefully.

prakrit: कयण्हाणाइविहाणो सह पिउणा ताहे पवणगइणा हं,तक्कालुचियं सव्वं गहिऊणं धूवपुप्फाइं
english: To drink with a spiteful widow Is like sharing a meal with her lover. Everything you want to eat You have to wash with soap.

prakrit: नागरजणेण सहिओ उप्पइओ खग्गसामलं गयणं,गच्छन्तेण कमेणं दिट्ठं भवणं जिणिन्दस्स
english: Friend, you have to sing the Kṛṣṇa's name aloud, To go and see what is to be done Is to conquer the world.

prakrit: वायन्तमउयमारुयमन्दन्दोलन्तधयवडगेहिं,सन्नंव करेमाणं आगमणत्थं जणोहस्स
english: Vayantama, yama ̄ ya ̄ maruma ̄ mi ̄, mandala ̄ n ̣ a, dhyavada ̄ geya, sannamma ̄ ma ̄ rya karema, a ̄ gamana ̄ tha janohasa.

prakrit: दुन्दुहिमउन्दमद्दलतिलिमापमुहेण तूरसद्देण,हक्कारन्तेव जणं जत्तासमए जिणिन्दस्स
english: A man who stares at you, Who turns his face away, With tears streaming down his face, Has a good life in this world.

prakrit: तत्तो कमेण पत्ता दिसि दिसि नच्चन्तअच्छरानियरं,मणहरगेयझुणीए आणन्दियभवियसन्दोहं
english: So give me the lotus leaf That does not stick to the nail mark. I will punish you for it If you refuse to bend it As long as you do.

prakrit: नाणाविहवत्थेहिं कयउल्लोयं मणोहरायारं,विच्छित्तीए लम्बियनिम्मलवरहारओचूलं
english: Like a coin tossed from the rafters, Like a garland of pearls plucked from a scorpion's beak,

prakrit: विरइयघणफुल्लहरं विचित्तलम्बन्ततारियाइन्नं,पवरपडिमण्डवेणं उच्छाइयअङ्गणाभोयं
english: A lonely flock of birds Is scattered all over the place, Like a banner proclaiming the birth of a god.

prakrit: नीसलतड्डियचन्दायएहिं मण्डियचउक्कियादेसं,फुल्लमयपवरतोरणसोहियमज्झं जिणिन्दगिहं
english: O moonlit night, Like the bustle of a crescent moon, I will conquer the jingling waters of the God of Love.

prakrit: तस्स य दुवारदेसे निम्मलजलपूरियाए वावीए,काउण पायसोयं निययवयंसेहिं परिवरिओ
english: When he offers her a bowl of neem water at the doorstep, She says:"" ""Please, please, go home as usual.

prakrit: जिणभवणदुवारट्ठियउच्चल्लियफुल्लमालियोहस्स,पुप्फाइं गेण्हन्तो अन्तो विहिणा पविट्ठो हं
english: A lotus blooms on the roof of your house, You fool, If you want to kiss a woman's cheek I am bound to fall.

prakrit: पूइय जिणिन्दबिम्बे काउं चीइवन्दणं जहाविहिणा,बाहिं नीहरिओ हं उवविट्ठो खयरमज्झम्मि
english: Wretched soul, How strange it is to see a woman's face reflected in a mirror, Like a cloud rising from the sky.

prakrit: वत्ते जिणमज्जणए इओ तओ तत्थ सञ्चरन्तो हं,अवरोप्परदंसियकोउगेहिं सहिओ वयंसेहिं
english: By the way, man, I'm just passing by. For looking down the road You'd better bear with me.

prakrit: कत्थइ विलासिणिजणं पेच्छन्तो नच्चमाणयं विविहं,कत्थइ कविवरनिवहं जिणचरियं अहिणवेमाणं
english: How many luxuries does a person enjoy, How many different kinds of nasty things does a poet enjoy, And how many lifetimes do we waste in idleness?

prakrit: वीणारवसंवलियं कत्थवि गीयज्झुणिं निसामेन्तो,विरइयविविहायारं कत्थवि य बलिं पलोएन्तो
english: The plucked strings of the lute quench the thud of the lyre, And the disjointed strings perform the sacrifice.

prakrit: कत्थइ तरुणनरेहिं दिज्जन्तं रासयं सुणेमाणो,सुरसुन्दरीहिं कत्थइ गिज्जन्तं धवलसङ्घायं
english: How much youth does a woman need To hear a melody, How much love does a beautiful woman need to hear a clap of thunder?

prakrit: एवं च जाव कोऊहलेण अवरावरेसु ठाणेसु,हिण्डामि तत्थ भवणे लीलाए समं वयंसेहिं
english: And go away, my boy,"" said the traveler, ""I will stay there with you for a while. At the same time I will visit you at your house in Leela.

prakrit: ताव मह माउलसुओ सहरिसमागम्म साइयं दाउं,वज्जरइ भाणुवेगो पभूयकालाओ दिट्ठो सि
english: So let me tell you, my poor boy, That while the sun is still shining I see the moonlight of the sky.

prakrit: कुसलं च पवणगइणो पिउभगिणीए य बउलवइयाए?,तत्तो य मए भणियं कुसलं सव्वेसि,अन्नं च
english: Where are you going? Are you going to tell me what to eat?"" he asked his wife, ""And when will you come home?

prakrit: एत्थेव आगयाइ इमाइं चिट्ठन्ति भद्द! जिणभवणे,अम्मापिऊण मूलं समागओ तेण सहिओ हं
english: That's the way it is! Your mother scolded you for coming here. Please, my dear, bear with me as I made love.

prakrit: सायरमवगụ̄धो सो तेहिं पउत्तिं च पुच्छिओ भणइ,कुसलं मह जणगाणं नागमणं कारणावेक्खं
english: When he comes home in the evening, He asks him what he wants from his daughter - in - law."" ""Tomorrow I'll have to explain why I hate my husband.

prakrit: अह सो मए पभणिओ वित्तप्पाया इमा हु जिणजत्ता,सम्पइ पुण अम्हाणं आगच्छसु पाहुणो ताव
english: Ah, so I have to spend the rest of my life with you, my dear. I will always be your guest.

prakrit: तो भणइ भाणुवेगो एवं एयन्ति किन्तु निसुणेसु,मह चित्तभाणुपिउणा लहुमागच्छेज्ज इति भणियं
english: So I said,'Go ahead and do it, but be patient; I think I've got a lot of catching up to do.

prakrit: ता चित्तवेग! सम्पइ तं चिय नगरम्मि एहि महतणए,उक्कण्ठिओ पगामं जं अच्छइ तुम्ह माउलओ
english: That's the mood! It's just the way you live in town. Wait a minute, you stupid bastard.

prakrit: एवं च तेण भणिओ अम्मापीईहिं अब्भणुन्नाओ,भाउसमेओ पत्तो नगरमहं कुञ्जरावत्तं
english: And he said,"" ""You fool, you fool, The path leads to the town of Kunjaravatta.

prakrit: तहिंय च चित्तभाणू मं दट्ठूं सुट्ठु हरिसिओ भणइ,सुन्दरमायरियं ते जमागओ अम्ह पाहुणओ
english: You look at me with such fondness, You turn your back on me, And tell me, darling, How lovely it is To be welcomed by my guests.

prakrit: निययपउत्तिं सव्वं कहिउं कयभोयणाइवावारो,पत्ताए रयणीए पासुत्तो पवरसयणीए
english: I'll tell you the whole story in due course: The traveler leaves, And the traveler follows.

prakrit: तत्थ य पभायसमए लवमाणे तम्बचूलनिउरम्बे,दिट्ठो अदिट्ठपुव्वो एसो सुमिणो मए तइया
english: At that moment I looked at you with such fondness, As if I were a traveler's son.

prakrit: किल धवलफुल्लमालं मणोहरं दट्ठु तग्गहट्ठाए,चलिओ हं न य सक्केमि गेण्हिउं तं जया कहवि
english: Please, tell that girl Jaya, Who after a long search Has reduced the size of her eyes to mere petals, Will not be able to walk again.

prakrit: केणवि मित्तेण तओ समप्पिया आयरेण मे गहिया,ओलम्बिस्सं गलए किल नियए ताव सा झत्ति
english: Have you ever smelt iron with a friend's milk? It's as if you've tried to kill an Olympian.

prakrit: पडिया मह हत्थाओ कत्थवि य गयत्ति नेय जाणामि,ताहे महन्तदुक्खं तव्विरहे मज्झ सञ्जायं
english: Believe me, I know how to tell a story, But my heart aches And my heart sighs for you.

prakrit: सुक्कावि मए एसा पुणोवि अमिलाणकुसुमिया विहिया,इय भणिऊणं केणवि कण्ठे विणिवेसिया मज्झ
english: I will never forget how, when I was dry, The fragrant jasmine bloomed again, Saying this:"" ""My heart swoons at the sound of someone's voice.

prakrit: ताव पडुपटहझल्लरिकाहलभम्भामउन्दसद्दालं,सोउं तूरस्स रवं झत्ति पणट्ठा महं निद्दा
english: There you are, Standing on the bank of the river, Sucking in the cool breeze As if it were a waterfall.

prakrit: तो हरिसविसायड्ढं दट्ठुं सुमिणं विचिन्तियं हियए,किं नाम मज्झ सूयइ अदिट्ठपुव्वं इमं सुमिणं?
english: So look around you, tell me, What is your name, my sleepy self, That I sleep without seeing you?

prakrit: का हन्दि! इमा माला विज्जा व सम्पया व मह होज्जा,दिन्ना केणवि नट्ठा पुणरवि लद्धा,न याणामि
english: Whose hand is it? This garland of jasmine, Wrapped in a blanket, Is my master's ornament. No one has ever plundered it But me.

prakrit: एवं अणिच्छियत्थो सुविणसरूवस्स उट्ठिओ अहयं,काउं पभायकिच्चं अह सहिओ भाणुवेगेण
english: And suddenly, with a goodly sigh, I rose to my feet. But for some reason, my friends muttered,"" ""I'm off.

prakrit: आरụ̄धो पासाए उवरिमभूमीए चित्तसालाए,मणिरयणकोट्टिमम्मी उवविट्ठो मत्तवारणए
english: And now that you've passed by, Your mind is absorbed in the earth, Like a drunkard climbing up and down the steps of a manirayan kotty.

prakrit: अह तं पभायदिट्ठं सिट्ठं सुविणं तु भाणुवेगस्स,निच्छइउं नो सक्कइ सोवि हु सुविणस्स सब्भावं
english: Ah, the beauty of your face, You silly girl, Don't be so naïve As to think you're a gentleman.

prakrit: चिन्तित्ता सुविणफलं विगप्पसङ्कप्पखित्तनियचित्ता,जा चिट्ठामो अम्हे खणन्तरं तत्थ ठाणम्मि
english: Thinking is the fruit of good thoughts And thinking is the enemy of bad thoughts. The letter we write Staying there for a while.

prakrit: ताव य वरनेवत्थो महग्घआभरमभूसियसरीरो,सव्वो वि नयरलोओ गन्तुं कत्थवि पयट्टोति
english: Every traveler stumbles upon a story Wherever he goes, It's all very expensive.

prakrit: तं दट्ठुं मए भणियं सबालवुड̣धो इमो जणो कत्थ,कयउवसोहो वच्चइ साहसु भो भाणुवेगम्ह?
english: Tell me, brother - in - law, How dare you ask me What makes me feel so good When I see you?

prakrit: भणियं च तेण निसुणसु अज्जं जं मयणतेरसी भद्द!,मयरन्दुज्जाणठियस्स तेण जत्ताए मयणस्स
english: Foolish girl, you're the one who made my heart ache!"" ""Dear friend, That's just the way it should be.

prakrit: एसो नरनारिगणो पूयत्थं तस्स वच्चइ पमोया,अम्हेवि हु गच्छामो पेच्छामो कुसुमसरजत्तं
english: Such is the nature of man, That at the moment he touches us We stare at a mass of gooseflesh.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं एवं होउत्ति दोवि सञ्चलिया,कयसिङ्गारा पयओ पत्ता य कमेण उज्जाणं
english: That's why I carry both my brother's and my wife's purse. Somebody has spilled the beans. It must be someone else's.

prakrit: कीलन्तकामिणीयणरणन्तनेउररवेण तरुनियरो,मयणमहूसवतुट्ठो गायइ इव चच्चरिं जत्थ
english: Long - eyed girls, Young men with plump breasts, Like a flock of peacock's tail feathers Singing from the very top of a mango tree.

prakrit: मलयानिलहल्लावियसाहाहिं विघुम्ममाणया धणियं,कोइलकयकलकोलाहलेहिं अफुडक्रवारालावा
english: A swarm of gnats pierces the surface of the Malayala hills, Like an endless stream of koelika flowers.

prakrit: अच्छउ ता दूरॆ च्चिय पाणिग्गहणाइयं तु सह तीए,अम्हाण मणोदइयं दंसणमवि दुल्लहं मन्ने
english: Well, you're a long way off, honey, and I'd love to hang out with you.

prakrit: किं मज्झ जीविएणं किंवा मह हन्दि! मणुयजम्मेण,जो विरहदुक्खसमणं तीए वयणं न पेच्छामि?
english: Should I live, or should I die? For what use is a human being if he cannot bear to suffer the pain of separation?

prakrit: अहवा चूयलयाए भणिएणं भविस्सई पभायम्मि,तीए सह दंसणयं अणुकूलो जइ विही होही
english: Ahava Chulyayya said,"" ""Mother - in - law, if you want to be with her, you have to bow down.

prakrit: गुरुविरहजलणजालावलीहिं सन्तावियस्स हिययस्स,अन्नो नत्थि उवाओ पियदंसणओसहं मोत्तुं
english: The sage was so distracted by the stream of tears streaming down his face That he could not help but sigh at the sight of his beloved.

prakrit: एमाइविगप्पेहिं पणट्ठणिद्दस्स मज्झ सा रयणी,चउजामावि हु तइया जामसहस्सोवमा जाया
english: My dear, You are so stubborn, my dear, That even after four nights You do not want to be angry.

prakrit: असरिसदूसहसन्तावतावियं कहवि माणसं मज्झ,फुडमाणम्पि न फुट्टं मन्ने तद्दंसणासाए
english: Tell me, I beg of you, How can a man be so touchy When he has no more food than he needs to eat?

prakrit: सीयलकरनियरेणवि सन्तावं फेडिउं मह असत्तो,अह लज्जिउव्व चन्दो अत्थगिरिं पाविओ तत्तो
english: If it weren't for the cool breeze blowing through the clouds, You'd be ashamed to have missed the moon.

prakrit: पच्चूसगयवरुम्मूलियाए उड्डीणससिविहङ्गाए,रयणिलयाए गलन्तिव कुसुमाइं तारयनिहेण?
english: Are not emeralds like the jasmine flowers in a flock of parrots, Like the nectar of an emerald flower in a flying sapphire?

prakrit: अह इन्ददिसा सहसा केसुयसुयतुण्डसच्छहा जाया,आसन्नसूरमण्डलवज्जरणत्थंव लोयस्स
english: Ah! the dark sky is suddenly overcast with blue skies, Loose are the rays from the thundercloud that is approaching.

prakrit: पडिबोहियकमलवणो पसरियखरकिरणपूरियदियन्तो,मेलियरहङ्गजुयलो तदणन्तरमुग्गओ सूरो
english: The full moon is like the rays of a flicker of a rainbow, Like the jujube on a woman's thighs Which then sets in motion the sun.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि अहयम्पि समुट्ठिऊण किच्चं पभायतणयं करिउं पयत्तो,भो सुप्पइट्ठ! तइया दइयाइ होही सन्दंसणम्ह इइ पहिट्ठमणो पगामं
english: Here I am, Sitting here for the night, Trying to figure out what to do next. Go to sleep! It's your mercy That keeps me from seeing you. This is the first step on my foot.

prakrit: एसोवि परिसमप्पइ विरहे सूरुग्गमॊत्ति सुपसिद्धो,सुरसुन्दरिनामाए कहाए तइओ परिच्छेओ ९५०
english: Aunt, It's past three o'clock And the sun is shining brightly. Tell me, my pretty girl, How long has it been Since you've had your period?

prakrit: अह भाओ भाणुवेगो समागओ पहसिओ ममं भणइ,गम्मउ उज्जाणम्मि चूयलयावयणमणुसरिउं
english: Oh! my brother! First you meet me, then you speak to me. Then I'll give you a bath in the steaming hot sun.

prakrit: हरिसाऊरियहियएण ताहि एवन्ति जपमाणेणं,तक्कालुचियं जाव य कायव्वं काउमारद्वं
english: If you want to enjoy nature, you have to chant it. If you like it, go and do it. It's because you love nature.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि निसुओ मङ्गलतूरस्स गहिरनिग्घोसो,पुट्ठो य मए भाया कत्थ इमं वज्जए तूरं?
english: What do you mean by that? It's only a matter of a few minutes, You stupid fool, How can I explain it to you?

prakrit: तो भणइ भाणुवेगो सम्मं जाणे न कारणं एत्थ,नवरं अमियगइगिहे भाविज्जइ एस तूररवो
english: So he says,"" ""I don't know what to do with you, brother - in - law."" ""Now it's my turn to say goodbye.

prakrit: अह चिन्तियं मए किं आसन्नपियासमागमस्सावि,अब्भहिओ सन्तावो फुरइ य वामं तहा नयणं?
english: Oh! why am I so anxious At the prospect of my beloved's return? For, my dear, Is it too early To tell which way to turn?

prakrit: ता भवियव्वं केणवि एत्थ नणु कारणेण ताहे मए,चूयलया वाहरिया समागया अह इमं भणिया
english: So what do you think? It's because I'm so naïve. Whether you ask me out or join in I'll tell you the truth.

prakrit: कत्थ इमो तूररवो केणव कज्जेण सम्ममुवलब्भ,आगन्तूणं भद्दे! सिग्घं चिय कहसु अम्हाणं
english: How am I supposed to manage the distance, Foolish visitor, When someone's business is on the line? Tell me, I beg of you.

prakrit: गन्तूणं चूयलया खणन्तराओ समागया धणियं,विच्छायवयणकमला पुट्ठा य मए इमं भणइ
english: Destroyed chickpeas: The poor farmer has found a way out, But the lotus bud, pierced by a scorpion, Says so to me.

prakrit: एत्तो विणिग्गयाए अमियगइगिहस्स दारदेसम्मि,भूरिजणसङ्कुलम्मी मए न लद्धो पवेसोवि
english: It's so windy here That I can't get in the way of the doormat. But don't let the crowd confuse me.

prakrit: तत्तो य बन्धुदत्तो पत्थुयवत्थुम्मि पुच्छिया भणइ,वरणम्मि एस भद्दे! महोच्छवो कणगमालाए
english: There you are, my friend, Asking how I'm feeling When you kiss my cheek. What a disgusting thing it is to touch a friend's cheek.

prakrit: सिरिगन्धवाहणसुओ गङ्गावत्तम्मि खयरनयरम्मि,नहवाहणॊत्ति सुम्मइ तस्स विइन्ना कणयमाला
english: The water of the Ganges flows smoothly, Like a river in spate, Like an earthenware pot in the middle of a stream.

prakrit: एवं वियाणिऊणं समागया एत्थ तुम्ह पासम्मि,कन्नकडुयम्पि तुम्हं साहिज्जइ मन्दाभागाए
english: And by the way, you're so close, my dear, That the twang in your ear Makes you look so miserable.

prakrit: तीए वयणं सोउं धसत्ति गुरुमोग्गरेण पहओ हं,मुच्छानिमीलियच्छो पडिओ भूमिए गयचेठ्ठो
english: She's so thin on her stomach That she is afraid of being angry with her master. But looking down at the ground she stumbles across a frown.

prakrit: घणसारसारगोसीसमीससलिलेण ताहि संसित्तो,सुकुमालतालविण्टयसीयलपवणेण गयमुच्छो
english: It's like having a lot of fun, Like making love with your lover, Like bathing in the lake of lotus.

prakrit: परिचिन्तिउं पयत्तो पेच्छह दुव्विहियविलासियं विहिणो,पियसङ्गमणोरहभंसणम्मि उज्जुत्तचित्तस्स
english: When you meet her you see that both of you are enjoying the luxury of marriage, That the passion for love is palpable And that her husband is happy.

prakrit: अहवा अन्नह परिचिन्तिज्जइ सहरिसकण्डुज्जएण हियएण,परिणमइ अन्नहच्चिय कज्जारम्भो विहिवसेण
english: Ahava anna is familiar to the townspeople through its thick, fragrant jasmine, Which in turn is distinguished from anna through its myriad occupations.

prakrit: कत्थ इमा कत्थ अहं अन्नोन्नं कत्थ गरुयअणुरागो,नवरं हयासविहिणा सव्वं चिय अन्नहा विहियं
english: Katha, ima, katha, am I, and the like. All is lawless without food.

prakrit: पुव्वम्पि हु जइ बुद्धी एरिसया आसि तुज्झ रे दिव्व!,ता कह मह पढमं चिय तीए सह दंसणं विहियं?
english: If you are so clever, my dear, How can you be so clever? Tell me, dear girl, Why did you want to hang out with me?

prakrit: काऊम दंसणं गरूयरायसहियं हयास! रे! दिव्व!,अन्नत्थ तं मयच्छिं जोडेन्तो कि नं लज्जिहिसि?
english: How embarrassed I am To see my husband in such a state! Oh! Divine! Would you not be ashamed If you could join him on the pyre?

prakrit: अविय नयणाण पडउ वज्जं अहवा वज्जस्स वड्डिलं किम्पि,अमुणियजणेवि दिट्ठे अणुबन्धं जाणि कुव्वन्ति
english: Aviya nayan padau vajjanam ahava vajjassa vaddilam kimpi, The sight of innocent people makes one tremble at the thought of unbreakable bonds.

prakrit: खणपरिचियदुल्लहलोयकारणे कीस! तं मिहसि?,मुञ्चसु गरुयविसायं विवरीओ हयविही जेण
english: What do you mean you're angry? You're angry? It's because you're annoying me. I can't take it anymore.

prakrit: एरिसदुविस्सहेवि हु सञ्जाए हिययं गरुयदुक्खम्मि,वज्जघडियंव मन्ने जं नवि सयसिक्करं जासि
english: It is with great sadness that I acknowledge my mistake. The thunderclap signifies the arrival of a new master.

prakrit: एमाइबहुविगप्पं चिन्तेमाणस्स गरुयसोगस्स,तव्विरहदूमियमाणसस्स तइया महं कुमर!
english: What a fool you are, Thinking only of yourself, Like a man possessed by a demon!

prakrit: पुणरवि सा सोमलया समागया किञ्चि हरिसियाव मणे,उवविट्ठा मं दट्ठुं सुट्ठुं विसायाउरं तइया
english: Once again, my darling, Don't think I've anything to do with you: You look at me all the time, You stare at me with such longing.

prakrit: ता भणइ कीस सुन्दर! दीससि तं दुम्मणोव्व अच्चत्थं,सुणिउं वरणयवत्तं,ताव निसामेसु मह वयणं
english: How handsome you are! You look at that damned woman. Listen to her say the following:"" ""There must be something wrong with me.

prakrit: भणियं च मए अज्जवि किं आसा कावि अत्थि अम्हाण,वज्जरसि जेण एवं सोमलए!,ताहि सा भणइ
english: Tell me, brother - in - law, what do I have to say about you today, my dear?"" she mutters, ""You fool, you bastard!

prakrit: तुह विरहे गयचेट्ठं दट्ठूणं ताव कणगमालं तु,चूयलया कल्लम्मि पट्ठविया तुम्ह पासम्मि
english: You're so fragrant That you look at me with longing, You turn your back on me, Like a stone pierced by a needle.

prakrit: सावि हु सहीहिं कहवि तुह सङ्गमसूयगेहिं वयणेहिं,आसासियावि वरई तुह सङ्गमपावमाणा उ
english: I will tell you the truth,"" he said, ""By the pleasure of your company And not by false promises.

prakrit: खणमेत्तं मुच्छिज्जइ उठ्ठियइ पुणोवि मुयइ हुङ्कारे,गायइ हसइ य वेवइरोवइ य खणेण उत्तसइ
english: A poor girl wipes away tears, gets up again, turns on her hips, and sings, Laughs, or acts as if she's still asleep.

prakrit: गहगहिया इव बाला असमञ्जसचेट्ठियाइ कुणमाणा,हसियावि सहिजणेणं नवि जाणइ किञ्चि हयहियया
english: A proud girl, With eyes wide open And a smile on her face, Has no knowledge of what is to come.

prakrit: तं पेक्खिऊण य मए विचिन्तियं जाव मुयइ नो पाणे,गुरुअणुरागा एसा ताव उवायं विचिन्तेमि
english: I have no desire to see you again, Not because I am curious, But because I think of you in the same way As a teacher.

prakrit: तत्तो तव्वुत्तन्तो कहिओ गन्तूण चित्तमालाए,तज्जणणीए उ मए एगन्तगयाए सव्वोवि
english: So tell me, traveler, How long has it been since you last sang a song to me?

prakrit: विन्नायसरूवत्था पासे आगम्म कणगमालाए,वज्जरइ चित्तमाला कीस तुमं पुत्ति! उव्विग्गा?
english: You silly girl, Why are you so forthright When there are lotuses all over the place? You fool, you fool! You fool?

prakrit: अच्छसि ओसन्नमुही भणियावि हु कीस देसि नालावं?,सुहसज्झं चेव इमं मा पुत्ति! विसायमुव्वहसु
english: Well, you look at me and say,"" ""Why not give it to me?"" ""Please, my son, Don't be so touchy! It's like a good wife gone astray.

prakrit: अम्हाण चित्तभाणू आयत्तो तं च पुत्ति! कन्ना सि,उचिओ य चित्तवेगो रूवेणं कलाहिं जं तुज्झ
english: My son, if you come with my senses, Why are you so anxious? Your senses will tell you what to do with your emotions.

prakrit: तस्स य उवरिं जाओ अणुरागो तुज्झ तेण सव्वम्पि,अमुकूलमिणं जायं मा चिन्तसु अन्नहा वच्छे!
english: There you go, my dear, You're all the same, So don't worry about the money you're making Going to waste!

prakrit: किन्तु तुह पुत्ति! जणओ गङ्गावत्तम्मि खयरनयरम्मि,पासम्मि गन्धवाहणविज्जाहरराइणो हु गओ
english: But you son! Look, the river Ganges is bursting at the seams. Get away, you scent - bearer.

prakrit: आगच्छउ सो सिग्घं कुसलेणं ताहे तुज्झ वीवाहं,महया विच्छड्डेणं कारिस्सइ चित्तवेगेण
english: Come, let me kiss your cheek, Your wife. Let me pierce through Your heart With a passionate embrace.

prakrit: एसोवि चित्तमासो वित्तप्पाउत्ति लब्भिही लग्गं,सिग्घं चिय पुत्ति! तुमं मा काहिसि किञ्चि उव्वेवं
english: That's the way it is."" ""Get up quickly, son! Don't let anyone fool you!

prakrit: एवं नियजणणीए भणिया सा विगयविरहसन्तावा,जाया मणयं सत्था समुट्ठिया ताहे से जणणी
english: And if the fiancée tells you she's having a child out of wedlock, You'd better be honest: There's something very special about that.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि सहसा समागओ ताओ खयरनयराओ,अमियगई से जणओ कयविणओ परियणेणेसो
english: Come here and meet me at once, you wretched traveler; from now on no one will know how to travel.

prakrit: ण्हाय विलित्तो भुत्तो उवविठ्ठो उवरिमाए भूमीए,अहयम्पि चित्तमालासहिया तत्थेव सम्पत्ता
english: There is no ruin in the earth But lies waste On the surface of the earth. For here, with a garland of reeds, Is the wealth of that place.

prakrit: कुसलपउतिं पुच्छिय नियदइयं ताहे चित्तमालाए,नियधूयाए पउत्ती सव्वावि हु तस्स अक्खाया
english: When he asked her what she wanted to eat, She replied:"" ""It's my heart, My daughter - in - law; I give it all to him.

prakrit: तं सोउं अमियगई साममुहो तक्खणेण सञ्जाओ,भणइ अहो! अइगरूयं समागयं अम्ह वसणन्ति
english: That night I slept peacefully, But when he awoke I thought,"" ""We're going to sleep together.

prakrit: तो भणइ चित्तमाला पिययम! किं कारणं नु वसणस्स?,तत्तो य अमियगइणा वज्जरियं पिययमे! सुणसु
english: So tell me, Chittamala piyyam! Why don't you settle down? So, please, let me have a drink of this incomprehensible liquor! Listen up!

prakrit: नरवइकज्जेणेत्तो गङ्गावत्तम्मि तम्मि नयरम्मि,सिरिगन्धवाहणस्स ओ पासम्मि गओ अहं तइया
english: The stream of the Ganges swallows you in a fit of jealousy, O carrier of sweet smells, I have passed by You.

prakrit: कयविणओ उवविट्ठो अत्थाणगयस्स राइणो पासे,सम्भासिएण य तओ निवेइयं रायकज्जं से
english: Somehow you've got there By the side of a singing lion, And in conversation you must be talking to another rake.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि सुन्दरि! पडिहारनिवेइओ अणुन्नाओ,अत्थाणम्मि पविट्ठो एगो विज्जाहरकुमारो
english: Here lies the beauty of mother - in - law! There lie the wonders of nature. At the very least the holy woman Is the wife of a wise man.

prakrit: विहियपणामो रन्नो पारद्धो एरिसं स वज्जरिउं,विज्जाहराण राया वेयड̣धे आसि जो देव!
english: Weeping and wailing, Are these the days of wisdom? The gods come only after we have spent the night in knowledge!

prakrit: संसिद्धसयलविज्जो ससुरासुरमणुयलोयविक्खाओ,सुरवाहणॊत्ति नामं विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टित्ति
english: In the name of the one who carries the jewel, The wheel of knowledge is turned upside down Like the bow of an old man.

prakrit: अवमाणवज्जियं जो विज्जाहररायलच्छिमणुहविउं,विक्खायजसं पुत्तं निययपए ठाविऊण तुमं
english: You dishonest son of a bitch, Who, for all intents and purposes, Pretends to be the youngest.

prakrit: संसारवासभीओ नाऊण असारयं विभूईए,रज्जसिरिं अवउज्झिय पडग्गलग्गं जरतणंव
english: Fear the world, For behold, I am bound to perish, For fear the strings of ropes That bend the rattle of a thunderclap.

prakrit: सिरिउसहनाहजिणवरवज्जरियं सव्वविरइरूवं जो,चारितं पडिवन्नो चित्तङ्गयमुणिवरसमीवे
english: Sirius, the thunderclap of victory is everywhere, Like the bow that falls four times in a row On the banks of the Chitangay.

prakrit: गहणा ' 'सेवणरूवं सिक्खं अब्भसिय गुरूसमीवम्मि,अहियसुओ पडिवज्जिय एगल्लविहारपडिमं सो
english: Jewels!"" cried the servant, ""And now at my master's feet I see a poor widow with loose hair.

prakrit: छट्ठ 'ट्ठमदसमदुवालसाइनाणाविहे तवोकम्मे,उज्जुत्तो विहरन्तो गामागरमण्डियं वसुहं
english: Chhath is here, Like a lotus on the moon, In the middle of the night, Brilliant as it were, Stretching across the village center.

prakrit: सम्पत्तो एत्थेव य वेयड̣धे चित्तकूडसिहरम्मि,तुम्ह पिया सुरवाहणविज्जाहरमुणिवरो अज्ज
english: Wealth alone is not enough, Weird man, Since your heart is heavy with desire, Today you will be my lover, Like a traveler's bow.

prakrit: पडिमापडिवन्नस्सिह सुक्कज्झाणेण खवियमोहस्स,लोयालोयपयासं उप्पन्नं केवलं तस्स
english: A wretched passion for pleasures based on flattery, Like the plowman's love, Exists only in him.

prakrit: तत्तो य तस्स वयणं सोऊणं गन्धवाहणो राया,हरिसवसवियसियच्छो भणइ तयं सायरं एवं
english: There you are, sniffing the scent of that fragrant fragrance From your mouth, Saying :'You must be sober '.

prakrit: भो आगच्छसु सङ्गय! आसन्नो,अज्ज तायवत्ताए,सहलीकयं म्ह जीयं केवलउप्पत्तिगब्माए
english: Come with me! Sit down! Today, mother - in - law, my life depends only on your loving - kindness.

prakrit: ससरीरपरिहियं सो सव्वं आभरणवत्थमाईयं,विलइय तस्स सरीरे तत्तो भण्डारियं भणइ
english: Everything outside the body is ornamental, but inside the body there is treasure.

prakrit: अद्धत्तेरसकोडी पवरसुवन्नस्स देसु एयस्स,पीईदाणं तत्तो तहत्ति सम्पाडियं तेण
english: Please, give me one hundred and fifty shekels of gold. There I can store all my wealth.

prakrit: तयणन्तरं च राया विज्जाहरनियरपरिगओ चलिओ,जणयस्स चित्तकूडे भत्तीए वन्दणनिमित्तं
english: After the arrow has passed, Raya walks across the wide aisle, To greet you with a loud clap of his hands.

prakrit: विज्जाविरइयवरविमाणआरूढपरियणाणुगओ,सुहनेवत्थविराइयनायरजणपरिगओ सहसा
english: A flight of fancy, A long flight of steps, A succession of pleasant and unusual people All at once.

prakrit: तेण सहिओ अहम्पि हु चलिओ मुणिपायवन्दणनिमित्तं,अह सव्वे सम्पत्ता आसन्ने चित्तकूडस्स
english: With that, my friend, I am ready to depart on account of the pleasantries offered. All this wealth is for the good of my heart.

prakrit: चउविहदेवनिकायं निवयन्तं दट्ठुं चित्तकूडम्मि,सविसेसहरिसियमणो वियसियमुहपङ्कओ राया
english: Seeing the four divine beings face to face, Keeping one's mind open, One cannot help feeling uneasy When one is surrounded by relatives.

prakrit: सिग्घतरं गन्तूणं बहुजणपरिवारिओ पयत्तेण,सुरकयकेवलिमहिमं थुव्वन्तं दिव्वनारीहिं
english: The happier the destination, The more likely it is that many families will visit; The sweeter the lamp, The thinner its fragrance.

prakrit: दट्ठूण मुणिवरं तं काऊण पयाहिणं च तिक्खुत्तो,बहुमाणवससमुट्ठियरोमञ्चयञ्चियसरीरो
english: The sharp arrow pierces the bow at the sight of the sage And the crow at the pyre, Like a panorama of many human settlements.

prakrit: भूमितललुलियमउडं पञ्चङ्गं करिय ताहे पणिवायं,पहरिसगलन्तनयणो अह एवं थुणिउमाढत्तो
english: The lotus of the earth looks like a panchang of acacia flowers, Like the tip of a spittle stuck in a snake's eye.

prakrit: जय जय जीवदयावर! सुक्कज्झाणेणदड्ढकम्मवण!,वोच्छिन्नभवनिबन्धण! जाइजरामरणदुक्खहर!
english: Jai jai, Jivadayavar! The rapture of the joys and sorrows! The dissolution of the ties of karma! The resurrection of the living!

prakrit: उप्पन्नविमलकेवलउवलद्धसमत्थणेयसब्भाव!,सासयसिवसुहसाहण! पत्तअहक्खायचारित्त!
english: Loud clapping of the hands, Loud cheering, Lovely laugh! It's just the nature of love!

prakrit: भयवं अणाइनिहणे परिब्भमन्ताण भवसमुद्दम्मि,दाउं हत्थालम्बं अम्ह समुत्तारणं कुणसु ७१
english: Fear has overtaken me, And my heart is aflame with ecstasy. Right now, at the tips of my hands, I must answer you,"" 71

prakrit: एवं थुणिऊण मुणिं मुणिमुहकमलनिहियमणनयणो,उवविट्ठो धरणीए नासन्ने नाइदूरम्मि
english: And do not look down at the lotus Placed in front of you As if it were a spittle, For there is nothing farther from the earth Than this.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि मुणिणा परत्थसम्पायणेक्करसिएण,गम्भीरभारईए पारद्धा देसणा एवं
english: Here and there the bow is bowed, The pledge is made, The burden is great, And the path is arduous.

prakrit: अइदुलहं मणुयत्तं असासंसारसागरगयाणं,कुगईण पउरभावा सकम्मवसगाण जीवाणं
english: I am only human, Singing the ocean of non - existence, Living the song of virtue and virtue.

prakrit: तम्पि हु जराभिभूयं आवासो रोगसोगवाहीणं,सारीरमाणसाणेयदुक्खसम्पायकलियन्ति
english: My brother, I am so thin and wretched, And suffer from illness, That I gather sorrow from all my feelings.

prakrit: पवणाहयधयवडचञ्चलाओ लच्छीओ तहय मणुयाणं,अणवट्ठिया य नेहा सुहिसयमपियाइजणविसया
english: There are clouds hovering over the horizon, People looking on, People sitting idle, And women making love While making love.

prakrit: विसयसुहम्पि हु परिणामदारूणं नारयाइदुहहेऊ,आरम्भपरिग्गहसञ्चियस्स पावस्स परिणामो
english: With long sighs I yield fruit, But with short bursts of laughter The consequences of sin Are twofold.

prakrit: अइभीसणेण बन्धेण गरूयपीडावहो खु जीवाणं,मिच्छावियप्पवसओ सव्वम्पि हु सोक्खमाभाइ
english: I am content with living my life in poverty, bound by selfishness, But I am completely content with what I have done wrong.

prakrit: अणवरयसम्पयट्टो मच्चू अवहरइ जीवसङ्घायं,एवं च ठिए भो भो भद्दा! सम्मं विचिन्तेह
english: The unattainable treasure of pearls Endures all life, And still you look on in amazement!

prakrit: केवलिभणियं धम्मं मोत्तूणं नत्थि किञ्चि अन्नन्ति,सरणं भवभीयाणं भवियाणं भवनिबुड्डाणं
english: Only those who believe in Dharma, Who do not believe in anything, Fear the divine, For those who fear the divine are bound by the divine.

prakrit: तम्हा कुणह पयत्तं दुलहं लद्धूण माणुसं जम्मं,जिणइन्दभणियधम्मे सासयसिवसोक्खहेउम्मि
english: For all your virtues, Being a good husband and a good man is the supreme happiness.

prakrit: सावज्जकज्जवज्जणरूवं परिगेण्हिऊण पव्वज्जं,खविऊण कम्मसत्तुं सासयसोक्खं वयह मोक्खं
english: Freedom is attained through circumspection, through penance, through sacrifice, through compassion, through sincere devotion to duty.

prakrit: इय केवलिणा भणिए विणिवेसिय करयलञ्जलिं सीसे,वज्जरइ गन्धवाहणराया उ तहत्ति जं भणह
english: It's only a girl who says:"" ""Stop wasting your time making love,"" ""But when you tell her you're not, She sniffs at everything you say.

prakrit: दाउं विज्जानियरं रज्जेण समं तु निययपुत्तस्स,नहवाणस्स तत्तो करोमि गिहवासचायन्ति
english: You are as good a teacher as any of the wise; I will instruct you in every way.

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि सुन्दरि! पत्थावं जाणिऊण पुच्छाए,विहियपणामेण मए पुट्ठो मुणिकेवली एवं
english: Here's that lovely girl! If you ask her how she knows the path, She'll tell you it's the mud of the mud.

prakrit: लोयालोयविलोयणकेवलनाणेण नायभावस्स,पच्चक्खं हि भयवओ एयं जमहं तु पुच्छिस्सं
english: Don't be so naïve, you fool, Loyalist. Yet, for fear of being caught, I am asking you all the same.

prakrit: एक्कच्चिय मह धूया जाया विन्नाणरूवसम्पुन्ना,पाणाणवि वल्लहिया नामेणं कणगमालत्ति
english: One day I'll wash away the pollen From the wilting arrows That stick to my cheeks. The waterman's wife calls me by the name of Vallahya.

prakrit: धूयाए को भत्ता होही मणवल्लहॊत्ति एयाए,चिन्ताए मह हिययं भयवं! निच्चपि अक्खलियं
english: Allow the washerman to wash my clothes. It's like washing a man's hair. Worry about it. It scares me! I'm still speechless.

prakrit: ता मणनिव्वुइहेउं साहिज्जउ एस अम्ह वुत्तन्तो,पाणिग्गहणं तीए को किर विज्जाहरो काही?
english: Tell me, my dear,"" she said, as I approached her. ""Is there anything you want to tell me about your husband?

prakrit: एवं च पुच्छिएणं केवलिणा सुयणु! एरिसं भणियं,मा भद्द! कुण विसायं थोव चिय एत्थ वत्थुम्मि
english: And only ask how old she is! I'll tell you this. Don't be silly! Put on some clothes. That's what I'm talking about.

prakrit: तुह धूयाए भत्ता सो होही जो इमम्मि वेयड̣धे,गुणकलियं पालिस्सइ विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टित्तं
english: The allowance that washes away from you is the same as that given to me by my wife, Who polishes the virtues with the help of a brilliant wheel.

prakrit: पुव्वभवनेहबद्धा तुह धूया तस्स पाणवल्लहिया,होही सयलन्तेउरललामभूया महादेवी
english: Poor Bhavane, The only thing that washes you clean is water from the well, That is, The lotus flower Mahadevi standing in a straight line.

prakrit: केवलिवयणं सोउं सञ्जाओ मज्झ गरूयआणन्दो,एत्थन्तरम्मि राया समुट्ठिओ वन्दिऊण मुणिं
english: Only in poetry do I conceal my pride, For here on earth the whole body of Raya is covered with gooseflesh.

prakrit: तत्तो रन्ना सहिओ समागओ तम्मि चेव नयरम्मि,अह रन्ना हं भणिओ बहुमाणजुयं इमं वयणं
english: There was a lot of running around, And the roads were slippery all the time. So I said,"" ""Run, boy, is that the way it should be For many young men?

prakrit: अइवल्लहावि धूया दायव्वा ताव कस्सइ नरस्स,जं एसा लोगट्ठिई तेणम्हे एरिसं भणिमो
english: What do you mean, poor girl, You're a coward? That's what I meant when I said,"" ""There are people like that out there.

prakrit: नहवाहणस्स दिज्जउ सा कन्ना जेण वित्तवीवाहं,निययपए ठविउणं सेवामो तायपयजुयलं
english: Give me a bath And I'll take care of you. For as long as I have money, Service given me by appointment Is bound to pay.

prakrit: तत्तो मएवि भणियं एत्थत्थे नत्थि किञ्चि वत्तव्वं,धूया कित्तियमेत्तं पाणावि हु तुम्ह आयत्ता
english: That's my sister - in - law's name. Don't talk to her about it. How much water do you need to wash yourself?

prakrit: सच्चिय धूया धन्ना सुण्हा जा होइ देवपायाणं,केवलिगिरावि सच्चा जं किज्जइ एरिसे विहिए
english: Truth alone triumphs, fortune alone vanishes, Devapayana alone prevails, But true wisdom resides in whatever one does.

prakrit: तुम्ह सुयं मोत्तूणं वेयड्ढगिरिम्मि होज्ज को अन्नो,विज्जाण चक्कवट्टी जस्स पिया होज्ज मह धूया?
english: Are you the kind of person who likes to lie on your back And be nasty to others? One way of putting it is by saying,"" ""I'm drunk.

prakrit: एवं च मए भणिए वियसियवयणेण राइणाणत्तो,सोमजसो जोइसिओ विवाहलग्गं निरूवेसु
english: And I said:"" ""Vyasavyavayana raina natu, so please, Mr. King, untie the marriage knot.

prakrit: तत्तो जोइसिएणं सम्मं आलोचिऊण आइट्ठं,वइसाहसुद्धपञ्चमिरत्तीए सोहणं लग्गं
english: Come, think of it while you're busy making love. For the good wife wants to be bound to her lover's bow.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं आएसं देह जेण गन्तूण,नियनयरेसञ्जुत्तिं विवाहकज्जस्स कारेमि
english: Then, my dear, As my body is about to depart, I will arrange for you to be married according to your wishes.

prakrit: तेणाणुन्नाओ हं सिग्घं चिय आगओ इहं सुयणु!,रायामच्चेहिं समं चन्दजसा ' 'इच्चनामेहिं
english: There goes the fire That burns so long, Like the rays of the moon In a dream.

prakrit: एएवि कणगमालावरणत्थं आगया मए समयं,कल्ले पभायसमए किल होइ वरणयं तीए
english: Aavi kanagamala ambarthanam means"" ""My time is fire, Tomorrow at dawn I will be killed"" ""and so on.

prakrit: एवं च ठिए एसा एक्का धूया सुट्ठु पिया ताव कणगमालम्ह,एईए अणुराओ सञ्जाओ चित्तवेगम्मि
english: And just like that, One washes, Soothes, and drinks the bitter nectar. It makes one feel good.

prakrit: ता जइ मणो 'णुकूलं सम्पाडिस्सं न एक्कधूयाए,एईयवि,ता सुन्दरी! किञ्च मए जीविएणन्ति?
english: If that man's wealth cannot be put together, That woman is beautiful! How can I live without him?

prakrit: उवयारेणं महया विमग्गिया राइणा सुयनिमित्तं,सिरिगन्धवाहणेणं मएवि दिन्ना इमा तस्स
english: Uvayarennen mahaya vimaggiya raina suyyake, Sirigandha vahanennen mevi dinna ima tasa.

prakrit: तं च इयाणिं अन्नहकाउं चाइज्जए न जं सुयणु!,एएण कारणेणं मे भणियं आगयं वसणं
english: I don't want to go to bed hungry! That's why I have to settle here tomorrow.

prakrit: एवं पिययमवयणं सोऊणं चित्तवेग! सञ्जाया,मह सामिणीवि विच्छायवयणिया चित्तमालत्ति
english: And the desire to sleep when one is drunk! My good wife, Sanjaya, is always distracted by distractions.

prakrit: तत्तो तीए भणियं मह चित्ते फुरइ एरिसं ताव,परिचयइ कणगमाला तव्विरहे जीवियमवस्सं
english: There she is, Sitting beside me, Making my heart swell with joy, Introducing me to the joys of being alive.

prakrit: कहकहवि मए जं सा तप्पावणसुयगेहिं वयणेहिं,पुव्विं सधीरविया एयं पुण अन्नहा जायं
english: Tell me, my dear, How can I escape, If only I had the strength To go on like this?

prakrit: भणियं च अमियगइणा एवं हि ठिए करेमि किं सुयणु!,जइ ताव न देमि इमं तो राया रूसइ अवस्सं
english: My brother and I are incompetent, so why should I sleep? If I don't give it to you, Raya will get angry.

prakrit: केवलिवयणा रन्नो अइगरुओ एत्थ आयरो जाओ,तेण इमाइ अदाणे अइगरुयं होइ मह खूणं
english: Only the poor widow can make a fool of herself, So let her go and steal my present.

prakrit: रुट्ठेण तेण वेयड्ढनगवरे जं न होइ आवासो,अइथोवं चिय एयं,अन्नम्पि विरूवयं होइ
english: Stay in that wretched town where you're not supposed to be, For here I am, And there you must be.

prakrit: अन्नं च गिण्हिस्सइ मड्डाइवि राया एयं न एत्थ सन्देहो,ताव वरं सयमेव य समप्पियानेहविद्धीए
english: There is no doubt about it,"" he said, ""Just count the days and nights, and don't worry about the next day.

prakrit: जइ पुण दिज्जइ एसा रायसुयं मोत्तु चित्तवेगस्स,ता तस्सावि अम्हाणवि पाणाणवि संसओ होइ
english: If I were to be granted such a state It would be by pure desire and passion. So, too, would be our existence and our existence.

prakrit: ता सुन्दरि! न हु कज्जं अन्नेहिं एत्थ बहुविगप्पेहिं,तह भणसु कणगमालं जह उज्झइ तम्मि अणुरायं
english: That's a beauty! I have no other work here. Try whispering something as simple as that.

prakrit: किञ्च उत्तमकुलप्पसूओ पियंवओ सयलजणमणाणन्दो,सूरो धीरो चाई नियपिउलच्छीअलङ्करिओ
english: Some good man, Some good woman, Dear friend, The sun will be kind to you, And the pearls will be nicely dyed.

prakrit: रूवेण जोव्वणेण य कलाहिं विज्जाहिं निम्मलगुणेहिं,विक्खाओ नहवाहणकुमरो सव्वम्मि वेयड̣धे
english: A young man's hair is like a lotus, A young girl's teeth are like nails, And a child's eyes are like jewels in a mirror.

prakrit: तत्तो स एव भत्ता कमागओ होउ कणगमालाए,न हु कज्जं अन्नेण अवायबहुलेण पुरिसेणं
english: Then you'll make more money, And you won't have to settle for less.

prakrit: एवं च अमियगइणा भणियाए ताहि चित्तमालाए,भणिया हं सोमलए! किं जुत्तं सम्पयं काउं?
english: And the incompetent woman speaks in such a mood, But my brother - in - law speaks in silence! What is the point in talking to me?

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं तं चेव य इत्थ गहियपरमत्था,नियधूयाए सरुवस्स एत्थ किमहं भणामित्ति?
english: So, do you see that my brother - in - law is here, or that I am here, my dear? What do you mean by"" ""Here are all the servants of the lord?

prakrit: तो भणइ चित्तमाला तीए गन्तूण भावमुलभसु,इच्छइ व नवा अन्नं पुरिसं गुणदोसकहणेण?
english: So you think she is on her way? She is full of passion, She wants some new food, To impart her virtues to men?

prakrit: नहवाहणं पसंसिय अब्भहियगुणंहिं,निन्दिऊणन्नं,तह कुणसु जहा इच्छइ वीवाहं एयतणएण
english: Take a bath, flout the rules of etiquette, and get married wherever you like.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए भणियं सामिणि! किं तं न याणसि सभावं,नियधूयाए जेणं आएसं देसि मह एवं
english: That's my brother - in - law's name! Don't you know, gentlemen, That whenever a bridegroom comes by You give him to me And I to you.

prakrit: मन्निस्सइ वीवाहं जं सा अण्णस्स,अच्छउ सुदूरं,सोउं पउत्तिमेयं मन्ने जीयं परिच्चयइ
english: A man's wife is as good as any other wife, So long a way off, So dear is her husband known to all.

prakrit: मह वयणं सोऊणं गुरुदुक्खसमाहया भणइ तत्तो,वियलन्तसकज्जलनयणसलिलसामलियगण्डयला
english: When my stomach aches And my gurus cry out in pain, I can hear the gooseflesh running down my cheeks.

prakrit: जं भणसि तुमं भद्दे! मज्झवि हिययम्मि फुरइ तं सच्चं,नवरं हयासविहिणो वसेण अइदुक्करं जायं
english: What you say is nasty! It's true, my dear. A young man who lives without a wife goes to bed early.

prakrit: तत्तो अइगुरुसोगं रुयमाणिं पिच्छिऊण नियदइयं,वज्जरियममियगइणा सुन्दरि! किं एत्थ रुन्नेणं?
english: There you are, angry girl, Chasing after the weeping woman. What's that crying for? It's the wretched beauty of the rainy season That's making us cry.

prakrit: किं मह थोवं दुक्खं नवरं न चएमि अन्नहाकाउं,सुइरम्पि चिन्तिऊणवि लभामि नन्नं उवायन्ति
english: Why should I suffer this pain And not eat my fill of food? I suppose you could help it by thinking how I am going to get it.

prakrit: तम्हा महिलागाहं मोत्तूणं आयइं निरूवेसु,रायसुयस्स अदाणे दोसे य गुणे विचिन्तेसु
english: Your wife has come to rob you of your pearls. Consider the faults in your generous giving.

prakrit: अन्न चं,कणगमाला बहुमाणपरा हु जणणिजणगाणं,पडिकूलिस्सइ वयणं न अम्ह गुणदोसकहणेण
english: I have plenty of food, I have a lot of clothes, And I know people who have. Please, don't take me for an innocent.

prakrit: अन्नञ्च,कन्नगाए भत्ता किल होइ गुरुअणुन्नाओ,तदणुन्नाए य जओ सयंवराईवि कीरन्ति
english: Only food, nothing more than the singing of kannadas. Teachers appreciate what is good for the soul.

prakrit: किच्च नहवाहणरायसुओ जाव न दिट्ठीइ गोयरे पडइ,तावच्चिय अणुराओ इमीए अन्नम्मि पुरिसम्मि
english: Kichcha nahavahana rayasu, When he does not look at you He falls on the cowherd. It is only because he tries to avoid you That he becomes like a poor man.

prakrit: निज्जियअणङ्गरुवे दिठ्ठे उण तम्मि होहिही रागो,ता किं सुन्दरी! बहुणा विगप्पसङ्कप्पजालेण
english: How beautiful it is to see your lover's face, To be angry with him, When he has already made her feel so guilty!

prakrit: गन्तूण कणगमालं सुनिउणवयणेहिं भणसु तं सुयणु!,एयम्मि वइयरम्मि जह अम्हं होइ न हु वसणं
english: Go to bed, Go to sleep! If you ask me what I like best, It's because I live where I don't belong.

prakrit: एवं च अमियगइणा भणियाए ताहि चित्तमालाए,भणिया हं सोमलए! पिययमवयणं लहुं कुणसु
english: And the incompetent woman speaks in such a way That her mood swings, And her brother - in - law sighs.

prakrit: तत्तो तहत्ति भणिउ समुट्ठिया जाव ताहि मे पुट्ठा,चन्दणनामा चेडी कत्थच्छइ कणगमालत्ति?
english: Tell me, son - in - law, Where did you get that name From?

prakrit: तीए भणियं एसा उवरिमभूमीओ उत्तिरेऊण,गिहउज्जाणाभिमुहा गच्छइ विच्छायमुहकमला
english: She said,"" ""It is like a lotus, Rising from the ground, Moving across the horizon Like a scorpion's beak.

prakrit: तं सोऊण विगप्पो उप्पन्नो मह मणम्मि एरिसओ,नूणं अलक्खियाए पिउवयणं तीए निसुयन्ति
english: You fool, you fool,"" said the girl, ""I beg of you to spare me the arrows you tossed at my ear.

prakrit: तेणेव इमा मन्ने जाया विच्छावयणिया बाला,ता जाव एत्थ गन्तुं विरूवमायरइ नवि किञ्चि
english: There goes the mother - in - law, As if she were a weeping child, So when she reached here There was nothing more for her to do.

prakrit: ता सिग्धं चिय गन्तु निवारणे तीए उज्जमामित्ति,एवं विचिन्तयन्ती अणुमग्गेणेव चलिया हं
english: She has a brilliant memory, And walks with discerning eyes Which prevent her from knowing what to count on.

prakrit: पत्ता य घरुज्जाणे इओ तओ तग्गेवसणनिमित्तं,जा परियडामि अहयं घणतरुयरसङ्कडिल्लम्मि
english: If I leave home, It's because I live in poverty. I'm stuck here with too many relatives.

prakrit: घणपत्तलकयलीहरमणोहरे तत्थ एगदेसम्मि,पत्तलतमालतरुतलहेट्ठनिविट्ठा मए दिट्ठा
english: When the clouds gather around the lotus leaf - That is when I see the white part of the tree, Like the leaf on a leaf - My gaze falls.

prakrit: किङ्किम्पि चिन्तयन्ती गलन्तथूलंसुसित्तगण्डयला,अणहुन्तमणसमीहियगुरुदुक्खा कणगमालत्ति
english: What makes you think she's smiling? A bunch of gooseflesh hangs around your neck, Like the scars from a heart attack.

prakrit: तत्तो विचिन्तियं मे किं मन्ने नियगिहं पमोत्तूण,एगागिणी हु एसा समागया एत्थ उज्जाणे?
english: So what do you mean, Vichintiyam, I've made up my mind, You stupid girl? Is this the way I want to be treated?

prakrit: ता एईइ अदिट्ठा पच्छन्नठिया निएमि जं कुणति,विन्नायसरुवत्था एसा नियजणयवयणस्स
english: That is the nature of my character, That is, the way I behave When I am alone.

prakrit: एवं विचिन्तिऊणं तुण्हिक्का कयलिथम्भअन्तरिया,खणमेगं जा चिट्ठामि तत्थ ता सुणसु जं जायं
english: And just think: You silly clumsy man, When I write to you in the middle of the night You listen to everything I say.

prakrit: दीहं नीससिऊणं एवं भणियं तु कणगमालाए,अज्जवि किमित्थ बहुणा विगप्पसङ्कप्पजालेण?
english: It's been a day of sighs and groans, How come you still have so many wrinkles on your face?

prakrit: सुचिरं विचिन्तिऊणवि तेण जणेणं न सङ्गमो ताव,पुन्नरहियाए मज्झं हयविहिणो विलसियवसेण
english: If you think well, There's no room for that man. Once he's gone I'll never see him again.

prakrit: अच्छउ सङ्गमसोक्खं दंसणआसावि दुल्लहा जाया,जाए तस्स विओगे फुट्टन्तं धारियं हिययं
english: Well, don't go swinging about in the hope of catching a thrill of rendezvous, For the stream will flow from there Until it bursts open.

prakrit: ता का अज्जवि आसा जेण तुमं हियय! फुट्टसि न झत्ति,खणमित्तदिट्ठवल्लहविओयवज्जेण दलियम्पि?
english: Why, my dear, are you still laughing? Don't you see the splinter? It looks like a doe peeping out of a vase of raisins.

prakrit: न य पिउवयणं सोउं इच्छियजणविरहकारयं हियं,वज्जघडियंव मन्ने जं नवि सयसिक्करं जासि
english: I do not want to be pitied, Not because I am averse to being liked, But because the clock strikes you It means that you have learned something new.

prakrit: अम्माए तायस्सवि वल्लहिया हं ति इय मरट्टो जो,हिययम्मि आसि मज्झं सोवि हु इण्हिं पलीणॊत्ति
english: Amma, I love you so much That when I die, my heart overflows with love.

prakrit: सुहसज्झं चिय एयं कज्जं मा पुत्ति! कुण विसायन्ति,एवंविहवयणेहिं पयारिया जेण अम्बाए
english: Well, my son, don't make such a mistake! Somebody is lying, So let's go and get married As soon as you can.

prakrit: जस्सुवरि तुज्झ इच्छा दायव्वा तस्स तं मए पुत्ति!,इयनियवयणं ताएण सम्पयं अन्नहा विहियं
english: As soon as you grant me your wish, my son! I will arrange for you to eat all my food.

prakrit: विन्नायमहसरूवो ओ अन्नहा जइ करेइ ताओवि,मह वञ्छियसम्पत्तीए सम्भवो ता कहं होउ?
english: O wretched man, If you want to eat anything at all, How can it be, my dear?

prakrit: एवं वियाणिऊणवि हियय! तुमं कीस मुञ्चसि न आसं,तज्जणसङ्गमविसयं जेणज्जवि जीवियं धरसि?
english: And look at that girl! Why don't you wish you were still alive When your life hangs in the balance?

prakrit: अहवा न कोवि दोसो पहुपरवसचिट्ठियस्स तायस्स,सुम्मइ जणम्मि पयडं कट्ठो खलु भिच्चभावॊत्ति
english: Ahava, don't blame me, You stupid girl, Just give birth to a boy Who looks just like you When you kiss him.

prakrit: जइवि हु विजियाणङ्गो रुवेणं जइवि सम्पयाकलिओ,जइवि हु उत्तमवंसो सक्खा सक्कन्दणो जइवि
english: If I win or cry, If I make friends, Then I will be a good man And prosper.

prakrit: तहवि न भावइ अन्नो पुरिसो तं हिययवल्लहं मोत्तुं,जइ एस निच्छओ हियय! तुज्झ ता किं विलम्बेण?
english: Don't be so naïve: The poor man will surely die if you leave him alone! How long will it take for you?

prakrit: एसो सो पत्थावो अइदुलहो पाविऒत्ति कलिऊणं,उज्जम विचिन्तियत्थे होउ अविग्धेण सम्पत्ती
english: Come, let us leave this stone, For it has proved a treasure of wisdom.

prakrit: एवं हि कए तायस्य देइ दोसं न किम्पि रायावि,दूसहविओयदुक्खस्स होइ एवं च वोच्छेओ
english: And please, don't blame me for being so touchy. But let the grief of separation alone be enough to heal your heart.

prakrit: एमाइबहुविगप्पा भणिऊणं चित्तवेग! सा बाला,कयमरणज्झवसाया आरụधा अह तमालम्मि
english: It's too early to say! That child, Who is so intent on dying Is already dead. So what do you mean, You shameless girl?

prakrit: दट्ठूण साहसन्तीए नवरि देहं पकम्पियं मज्झं,न वहइ वाया कहवि हु थक्काओ सव्वसन्धीओ
english: When she sees a brave bridegroom's body She embraces me, But does not tell me in words That I am exhausted.

prakrit: तत्तो य कणगमाला आरुहिऊणं तमालसाहाए,बन्धिय निउत्तरीयं बन्धइ नियकन्धराभोए
english: That is why one who touches the lotus tastes like a tamarind, One who is bound by ties attains immortality.

prakrit: अह पभणिउं पयत्ता अम्मे! जं किञ्चि बालभावाओ,पभिइं किलेसिया तं तं खमियव्वं महं संव्वं
english: Oh, my poor girl! Whatever feelings you may have had as a child, Please spare me those feelings.

prakrit: ताय! तुमम्पि हु मह खमसु सम्पयं पणयपरवसाइ मए,पुव्विं किलेसिओ जं परलोयं पत्थिया अहयं
english: You fool, all I have to lose Is my business as a tailor. I owe it to you, dear girl, To restore the stone on my back.

prakrit: जणणीसमहियनेहे! सोमलए! खम किलेसिया जं सि,सुसिणिद्धसहीसन्दोह! खमसु जं किञ्चि अवरद्धं
english: Mother - in - law! Slow down! For how long have you been keeping quiet? Stop wasting your time looking for someone else.

prakrit: खणमित्तदिट्ठ! वल्लह! हिययब्भन्तरपविट्ठ! निसुणेसु,पत्थेमि किञ्चि सामिय! पाणच्चायं करेमाणी
english: Look at that girl! Brilliant! Look at her breasts! Silly! I'd rather have a bath! It's the woman who makes the water flow.

prakrit: तुह सङ्गमरहियाए एसो जम्मो हु ताव वोलीणो,अन्नभवे पुण सामिय! तं चिय मह वल्लहो हुज्जा
english: It is with pleasure that I meet you, That you speak so eloquently, My dear! For he loves me so much.

prakrit: अन्नं भणामि सामिय! जइवि हु अइनिट्ठुरं इमं वयणं,तहवि हु तुह आवयावारणत्थमेसो म्ह निब्बन्धो
english: I beg of you, Samia! If you promise to stay with me as long as I stay with you, I shall be bound to you in the true sense of the word.

prakrit: नीसर मह हिययाओ रुद्धे कण्ठम्मि पासएणहवा,सक्केसि न नीसरिउ सामिय! मह पाणवल्लहय!
english: Poor fellow, Stop dragging me by the hair on your neck. Please, don't be so touchy! I'm a waterman!

prakrit: मन्ने च किञ्चि लद्धं हयविहिणा मरणकारणं अन्नं,मह तेण कारणेणं तुमए सह दंसणं विहियं
english: I have nothing to hide,"" he said, ""The cause of my death is hunger, and I must live with you because of it.

prakrit: वणदेवयाओ! निसुणह तुम्ह पसायाओ अन्नजम्मेवि,सो खणदिट्ठो लोगो दइओ मह होज्ज,नन्नॊत्ति
english: O forest god! Your anger has destroyed the grain fields. Please, my friend, spare me this pain. It's my fault.

prakrit: एवं भणिउं तीए मुक्को अप्पा अहोमुहो झत्ति,एत्थन्तरम्मि गयणे समुट्ठिया एरिसा वाया
english: And she said,"" ""Fist, Appa! Ahomuoh jhatthi!"" ""With these words the whole congregation groaned As Erisa spoke.

prakrit: मा मा साहसमेयं आयर भद्दे! समुच्छुगा होउं,सो चेव तुज्झ भत्ता होही नणु चित्तवेगॊत्ति
english: Don't be so hasty! Just be polite. It's your allowance, my dear. It won't hurt your feelings.

prakrit: तत्थेव लग्गदिवसे पाणिग्गहणं भविस्सई तेणं,अह सुन्दरि! एत्थत्थे मा किञ्चिवि कुण विसायन्ति
english: Then, on the very first day of the festival, she touched the water hyacinth. Oh! beautiful one! No one can spoil anything here.

prakrit: वयणाणन्तरमेव हि तुट्टो से पासओ,तओ अहयं,तव्वयणगलियसज्झससत्थसरीरा गया पासे
english: Vayanantaramev, You have passed by by a little while, But here I am. By the way, the traveler's wife has passed by seven times.

prakrit: तत्तो सलज्जवयणा भणिया य मए न पुत्ति! तुह जुत्तं,एरिसमायरिउं जणणिजणगमाईणदुहजणयं
english: That gentleman said,"" ""No, my son!"" ""Your lips, dear girl, Are a source of grief to those who know how to be affectionate.

prakrit: तत्तो य तीइ भणियं अम्बे! अम्हारिसाण किं अन्न,एवं हि गए काउं जुत्तं मरणं पमोत्तूणं?
english: There she is, my dear! What food is there for us to eat, And who has gone so far as to invite death?

prakrit: जओ वरि मरणं मा विरहो विरहो अइदूसहो 'म्ह पडिहाइ,वरि एक्कं चिय मरणं जेण समप्पन्ति दुक्खाइं
english: As long as death does not separate us, We are bound to be divided. But death alone is the remover of all sorrows.

prakrit: तत्तो य मए तीसे कहिओ सव्वोवि पुव्ववुत्तन्तो,भणिया य पुत्ति! सम्पइ किं तुह पडिहासए काउं?
english: So I told her,"" ""Everyone is smiling."" ""Tell me, daughter - in - law! Have you forgotten everything?

prakrit: अह तीए वज्जरियं लज्जं मोत्तुं भणामि एयं तु,नवि मज्झ करे लग्गइ अन्नो पुरिसो इहं जम्मे
english: Ah! what a shame! I suppose you are right; It's just the way things work.

prakrit: हसिऊण मए भणियं देवयवयणाउ सिद्धमेयन्ति,किन्तु कह तुज्झ जणओ छुट्टिस्सइ गन्धवाहणओ?
english: Laughing makes my brothers and sisters perfect their divinations, but who are you to tell me that you are a man of fragrance?

prakrit: एत्थन्तरम्मि पुणरवि गयणे वाया समुट्ठिया एसा,मा! कुणह बहुविगप्पे मह वयणं ताव निसुणेह
english: Here I am again, Singing in unison. For how long can I keep on singing?

prakrit: गन्तूणं सोमलया साहउ जणयस्स एरिसं वयणं,भणिया बहुप्पगारं भणइ तओ कणगमालेवं
english: Destroy Somalaya! This is the way of the wise. When a man speaks in a loud voice He speaks as though he had corn.

prakrit: जं चेव कुणइ ताओ तं चेव मज्झ बहुमयं सव्वं,जइ होइ सुन्दरं इह तायस्सवि कीरइ तयन्ति
english: Whatever you do, I take very seriously; however beautiful it may be, that is for the good of all.

prakrit: तत्तो अविगप्पं से वरणाइं पडिच्छियव्वन्ति,एवं हि कए कमसो होही इट्ठत्थसम्पत्ती
english: So recklessly do the Varnas lie low, And how little is the wealth of this place?

prakrit: इय देवयाए वयणं सोऊणं चित्तवेग! अम्हाणं,सञ्जातो गुरुतोसो ततो य मए इमं भणियं
english: It is the God of Love's mind that makes one sleep! But, my dear, I speak in this way only because it satisfies my Guru.

prakrit: मणवञ्छियवत्थुम्मी मा कीरउ पुत्ति! कावि आसङ्का,कवडेणवि तेण तुमं मन्नसु नियजणयवयणन्ति
english: What do you mean, you silly girl! Don't worry, girl,"" he whispered, As if he didn't even know you existed.

prakrit: एवं च देवयाए वयणं अन्नस्स नेव कहियव्वं,मा विन्नायसरूवो विरूवमायरइ सो राय
english: And the gods will tell you never to eat rice again."" That's the way it goes.

prakrit: एयम्मि कए पयडे लोयपवायाउ नायपरमत्थो,राया 'वस्सं तुह वल्लहस्स आयरइ असुहन्ति
english: Why, my poor girl, Are you so naïve As to fall in love with me? In this world there is no hope of finding a lover like you.

prakrit: तो भणइ कणगमाला एवं एयन्ति नत्थि सन्देहो,ता अम्बे! पत्थुयत्थे उज्जम किं एत्थ बहुएण?
english: Tell me, then, That the jasmine is pale And there are no more doubts: Mother - in - law! Brighter still than the banyan, What's the point?

prakrit: तत्तो य मए गन्तुं सिट्ठं एयं तु चित्तमालाए,भणिया बहुप्पगारं तुह धूया भणइ एवं तु
english: There I go, Sitting at your feet, Thinking of you all the time, Like washing your face with lotus flowers.

prakrit: जं किञ्चि भणइ ताओ जं चिय इह बहुमयं तु अम्बाए,जं चेव य सगुणतरं मएवि तं चेव कायव्वं
english: Whatever you say, do it with all your might; whatever you do out of courtesy I will give it to you.

prakrit: जह अब्भुदओ तायस्स होइ,जह होइ नावया कयावि,तह चेव य कायव्वं मएवि,किं एत्थ अन्नेण?
english: As the God, so be it, As the boat, so the canoe, So be it with me, What does it mean?

prakrit: तत्तो य चित्तमाला तव्वयणं कहइ निययदइयस्स,तं सोउं अमियगई हरिसियवयणो इमं भणइ
english: So long as you are determined not to cause annoyance, I will tell you the same thing That I will do to anyone who bothers.

prakrit: सुन्दरमणुट्ठियं हन्दि! मज्झ धूयाए जणयभत्ताए,दक्खिन्नवयणविन्नामपगरिसो दंसिओ एवं
english: Handsome man! I've washed my clothes in public, But look how you've treated me Now That I live in a village without a headman.

prakrit: तत्तो पभायसमए रायामच्चेहिं वरणयं तीसे,महया विच्छड्डेणं विहियं कयजणयआणन्दं
english: At that moment I heard your voice repeated in a loud voice:"" ""Why, my dear, is there anyone here who does not hear you?

prakrit: एवं च ठिए तुह मणनिव्वुइहेउं तीए वयणेण आगया अहयं,कहणत्थं पत्थुयवत्थुवित्थरस्सेत्थ तुह पासे
english: And by the way, I've already passed you by,"" she said, ""By the fire of love, Which means you have everything in common with me.

prakrit: ता मा सुन्दर! वरणयसवणाओ दुम्मणो तुमं होसु,जं देवयाए वयणं अलियं न य हवइ एयं तु
english: So don't be nice! You silly demon! If the gods do not allow you to speak, You are the one who does.

prakrit: एवं च कणगमालाभाणइ न नाह! तं पमोत्तूण,अन्नस्स करो लग्गइ मह हत्थे इत्थ जम्मम्मि
english: And don't you see that the jasmine is limping! Touch her gently. Wait till she puts her hand on my thigh.

prakrit: देवयवयणं जइ सच्चयं ता धरेमि नियपाणा,तदभावे पुण सरणं मरणं मह निच्छओ एसो
english: If I speak the truth, I will abide by it; if I repeat it, death is certain to come to me.

prakrit: भो सुप्पइठ्ठ! एवं सोमलयावयणसवणओ तइया,जायं मणयं मह माणसस्स सत्थत्तणं तत्तो
english: O sleeper! And you, son of a bitch, Are the only thing that can stop me from being a man.

prakrit: एवं विचिन्तियं मे केवलिणा जेण एरिसं भणियं,पुव्वभवनेहबद्धा होही भज्जत्ति,ता एयं
english: And whichever part of me says something like that, That's the way it should be said: There must be something else going on in my heart.

prakrit: सम्भवइ नूण अम्हं अवरोप्पदंसणाओ अइगरुओ,अणुराओ जाओ जं सुम्मइ लोयप्पवाओ य
english: It is possible that I may not see you again, O fool, At the mere thought of your moving into silence.

prakrit: पसुवइणो रोसारुणपडिमासंकंतगोरिमुहअंदम्,गहिअग्घपंकअं मिअ संझासलिलंजलिं णमह
english: Bow before Siva's offering to Twilight, The water held in his cupped hand. Reflecting Gauris moonlike face, Now flushed with jealous anger, It looks more like a crimson lotus

prakrit: अमिअं पाउअकव्वं पढिउं सोउं च जे ण आणंति,कामस्स तत्ततत्तिं कुणंति ते कह ण लज्जंति
english: Shame on those who cannot appreciate This ambrosial Prakrit poetry But pore instead Over treatises on love

prakrit: सत्त सआइं कइवच्छलेण कोडीअ मज्झआरम्मि,हालेण विरइआइं सालंकाराण गाहाणं
english: Among countless elegant poems, King Hala, patron of poets, Has selected seven hundred.

prakrit: उअ णिच्चलणिप्पंदा भिसिणीवत्तम्मि रेहइ वलाआ,निम्मलमरगअभाअणपरिट्ठिआ संखसुत्ति व्व
english: Look at that heron Standing absolutely motionless On the lotus leaf. It is just like mother of pearl In a setting of spotless emerald.

prakrit: ताव च्चिअ रइसमए महिलाणं विब्भमा विराअंति,जाव ण कुवलअदलसच्छहाइ मउलंति णअणाइं
english: While making love, women go on enticing men Up to the very end When their eyes, Long and oval like the petals of the waterlily, Close

prakrit: अत्ता तह रमणिज्जं अंहं गामस्स मंडणीहूअं,लुअतिलवाडिसरिच्छं सिसिरेणकअं भिसिणिसंडं
english: Look, mother-in-law! That lovely mass of lotuses Used to be the most beautiful thing in our village, But now winter has made them look Like a sesame field just after harvest

prakrit: किं रुअसि ओणअमुही धवलाअंतेसु सालिछेत्तेसु,हरिआलमंडिअमुही णडि व्व सणवाडिआ जाआ
english: Cheer up! Don't cry for the paddy turning white. There's the field of hemp in bloom Like a dancer with her face painted yellow!

prakrit: सहि एरिसि च्चिअ गई मा रुव्वसु तंसवलिअमुहअंदं,एआण वालवालुंकितंतुकुडिलाण पेम्माणं
english: Friend, this is just the way things happen— Stop your tears, don't turn your face away— Like the tendrils of a young cucumber, One's affections twine around an object That does not stay.

prakrit: पाअपडिअस्स पइणो पुट्ठिं पुत्ते समारुहंतम्मि,दढमण्णुदूमिआइ विहासो घरिणीअ णिक्कंतो
english: When their little son Climbed on her husband's back As he knelt at her feet, She could not help laughing Despite her fierce anger.

prakrit: रंधणकम्मणिउणिए मा जूरसु रत्तपाडलसुअंधं,मुहमारुअं पिअंतो धूमाइ सिही ण पज्जलइ
english: Don't get annoyed: There's nothing wrong with your cooking. That the fire won't burn but only smokes Is because it wants to inhale your breath That has the fragrance of red trumpetflowers.

prakrit: घरिणीअ महाणसकम्मलग्गमसिमइलिएण हत्थेण,छित्तं मुहं हसिज्जइ चंदावत्थं गअं पइणा
english: The husband laughed at his wife's face Which, smudged with soot That stuck to her hand from kitchen work, Looked more than ever like the moon.

prakrit: किं किं दे पडिहासइ सहीहि इअ पुच्छिआइ मुद्धाए,पढमुग्गअदोहलिणीअ णवर दइअं गआ दिट्ठी
english: When her friends asked the young wife Who was pregnant for the first time What she craved most She simply looked at her husband

prakrit: अमअमअ गअणसेहर रअणीमुखतिलअ चंद दे छिवसु,छित्तो जेहि जिअअमो ममं पि तेहिं चिअ करेहिं
english: Sweet moon, Crest jewel of the sky, Beauty spot on the face of night, Touch me with the very same rays With which you've touched my most dearly beloved.

prakrit: एहिज्ज सो पउत्थो अहअं कुप्पेज्ज सो वि अणुणेज्ज,इअ कस्स वि फलइ मणोरमाण माला पिअअमम्मि
english: First let my dear husband come home, Then let me give him a scolding, And then let him do his best to bring me round. There must be someone who can get all three wishes.

prakrit: कोसंवकिसलवण्णअ तण्णअ उण्णामिएहि कण्णेहिं,हिअअट्ठिअं घरं वच्चमाण धवलत्तणं पाव
english: Young calf, Blushing red as a tender mango shoot, Running with ears pricked Towards the house of your desire, Assume the cool whiteness of a bull!

prakrit: अलिअपसुत्तअ विणिमीलिअच्छ दे सुहअ मज्झ ओआसं,गंडपरिउं वणापुलइअंग ण पुणो चिराइस्सं
english: Dearest, I know you are not really asleep, Just keeping your eyes closed. I can see goose pimples rising as I kiss your cheek. I won't be late again.

prakrit: असमत्त मंडण च्चिअ वच्च घरं से सकोउहल्लस्स,वोलाविअहलहलअस्स पुत्ति चित्ते ण लग्गिहिसि
english: Don't bother about your makeup, girl, Just go to him quickly, while he wants you. Once his longing is over He won't give you a thought.

prakrit: आअरपणामिओट्टं अघडिअणासं असंहअणिडालं,वण्णघिअलित्तमुहिए तीए परिउंवणं भरिमो
english: I will never forget how, When her face was smeared with red ghee, We kissed, Carefully pouting our lips So that our noses and foreheads Wouldn't meet.

prakrit: आणासआइ देंती तह सुरए हरिसविअसिअकवोला,गोसे वि ओणअमुही अह से त्ति पिअं ण सद्धहिमो
english: I refuse to believe that she who, Cheeks flushed with excitement, Is so demanding while making love Can really suit him, However meek she may be next mornin

prakrit: पिअविरहो अप्पिअदंसणं च गरुआइ दो वि दुक्खाइ,जीअ तुमं कारिज्जसि तीअ णमो आहिजाईए
english: Being separated from what is dear And being forced to look at what isn't Are two causes of grief. I bow to your good breeding Which demands that you act as you do.

prakrit: ण कुणंतो च्चिअ माणं णिसासु सुहसुत्तदरविवुद्धानं,सुण्णइअपासपरिमुसणवेअणं जइ सि जानंतो
english: You would not be so touchy If you knew the pain of falling asleep beside one's lover And waking up in the middle of the night To discover that the bed is empty.

prakrit: णवलइपहरं अंगे जहिं जहिं महइ देअरो दाउं,रोमंच दंदराई तहिं तहिं दीसइ वहूए
english: At whichever part of her body Her husband's younger brother Aims the tender twig Gooseflesh raises a palisade of sticks.

prakrit: अज्ज मए तेण विणा अणुहूअसुहाइ संभरंतीए,अहिणवमेहाण रवो णिसामिओ वज्झपडतो व्व
english: Today, As I think of the pleasures I've had Without him, The thunder of the first rain clouds Sounds like the executioner's drum.

prakrit: णिक्किव जाआभीरुअ दुद्दंसण णिंवकीडसारिच्छ,गामो गामणिणंदण तुज्झ कए तह वितणुआइ
english: Headman's son, How heartless you are! Shying away from your wife You rarely show yourself, Like a worm in a neem berry. Yet because of you The whole village is pining away.

prakrit: पहरवणमग्गविसमे जाआ किच्छेण लहइ से णिद्दं,गामणिउत्तस्स उरे पल्ली उण से सुहं सुअइ
english: Lying on his breast, Rough with the scars of many a wound, The headman's wife finds it difficult to rest, But his village sleeps sound.

prakrit: अह संभाविअमग्गो सुहअ तुए च्चेअ णवर णिव्वूढो,एण्हिं हिअए अण्णं अण्णं वाआइ लोअस्स
english: What good old-fashioned honesty! But really, my dear, You're the only one who goes in for it. Nowadays people think one thing and say another.

prakrit: उण्हाइ णीससंतो कीस मह परंमुहीअ सअणद्धे,हिअअं पलीविउं अणुसएण पुट्ठिं पलीवेसि
english: What do you think you are doing, Embracing me from behind? First you set fire to my heart And then you start burning my back With these hot sighs of remorse.

prakrit: दिअरस्स असुद्धमणस्स कुलवहूणिअअकुड्डलिहिआइ,दिअहं कहेइ रामाणुलग्गसोमित्तिचरिआइं
english: The good wife takes all day To explain to her importunate young brother-in-law The paintings on the walls of their house That depict the adventures of LaksmanRamas devoted younger brother.

prakrit: चत्तरघरिणी पिअदंसणा अ तरुणी पउत्थवइआअ,असई सअज्जिआदुग्गआ अ णह खंडिअं सीलं
english: Young and attractive and her husband abroad, Living in poverty at a busy crossroad, With loose women in the neighborhood, —You're not telling me she's still chaste?

prakrit: अहिआइमाणिणो दुग्गअस्स छाइं पइस्स रक्खंही,णिअवंधवाण जूरइ घरिणी विहवेण एंताणं
english: Protecting the self-image of her husband, Who is poor but proud of his breeding, The wife scorns her own relatives As they arrive with rich presents.

prakrit: साहीणे वि पिअअमे पत्ते वि छणे ण मंडिओ अप्पा,दुग्गअपउत्थवइअं सअज्जिअं संठवंतीए
english: Her husband is at hand And the festival in full swing. Yet she delays putting on her jewels To hearten the woman next door Who is poor And whose husband has still not returned.

prakrit: सब्भावणे हभरिए रत्ते रज्जिज्जइ त्ति जुत्तम् इणं,अणहिअए उण हिअअं जं दिज्जइ तं जणो हसइ
english: To fall in love with a man who returns your love, One who is full of kindness and affection, Makes sense. But to give one's heart to a man who is utterly heartless Is laughable.

prakrit: आरंभंतस्स धुअं लच्छी मरणं व होइ पुरिसस्स,तं मरणम् अणारंभे वि होइ लच्छी उण ण होइ
english: If a man shows initiative There is the prospect of either wealth or death. Even if he lacks initiative, death is certain, Wealth is not.

prakrit: अक्खडइ पिआ हिअए अण्णं महिलाअणं रमंतस्स,दिट्ठे सरिसम्मि गुणे सरिसम्मि गुणे अईसंते
english: While making love to another woman His beloved will come to mind Both when he sees and doesn't see A familiar trait.

prakrit: णइपूरसच्छहे जोव्वणम्मि अइपवसिएसुदिअहेसु,अणिअत्तासु अ राईसु पुत्ति किं दड्ढमाणेण
english: Silly girl, Youth races past Like a river in spate, The days are fleeting And the nights unreturning. So why this stubborn sulkiness?

prakrit: कल्लं किर खरतिअओ पवसिहइ पिओ त्ति सुव्वइ जणम्मि,तह वड्ढ भअवइ णिसे जह से कल्लं चिअ ण होइ
english: Every one knows the hardhearted lover Leaves at dawn. Venerable Night, stretch on So that morning will not come.

prakrit: होंतपहिअस्स जाआ आउच्छणजीअधारणरहस्सं,पुच्छंती भमइ घरं घरेण पिअविरहसहिरीओ
english: As her husband is about to depart She goes from door to door Asking all the women who suffer from absent husbands For the secret of surviving the farewell.

prakrit: अण्णमहिलापसंगं दे देव्व करेसु अम्ह दइअस्स,पुरिसा एक्कंतरसा ण हु दोसगुणे विआणंति
english: O god, please Let my husband form other attachments, For men who have experience of one person only No longer appreciate what's good and what's bad.

prakrit: थोअं पि ण णीइ इमा मज्झण्हे उअ सरीरतललुक्का,आअवभएण छाही वि ता पहिअ किं ण वीसमसी
english: Wayfarer, Your shadow is hiding beneath your body, Not showing one bit of itself for fear of the midday sun, So why don't you too take a rest?

prakrit: सुहउच्छअं जणं दुल्लहं पि दूराहि अम्ह आणेंत,उअआरअ जर जीअं पि णेंत ण कआवराहोसि
english: By bringing that man Who keeps his distance To ask me how I'm feeling, You have proved a blessing. Now, fever, if you take my life, I will not complain.

prakrit: आम जरो मे मंदो अहव ण मंदो जणस्स का तत्ती,सुहउच्छअ सुहअ सुअंधगंध मा गंधिरिं छिवसु
english: Why should anyone care Whether my fever has abated or not? You, my dear, asking how I am And smelling so fragrant, Do not touch me who stink of fever.

prakrit: सिहिपिच्छलुलिअकेसे वेवंतोरु विणिमीलिअद्धच्छी,दरपुरिसाइनि विसमिरि जाणसु पुरिसाण जं दुक्खं
english: Your long hair sways like a peacock's fan, Your thighs quiver, your eyes half close, With long pauses you sort of play the man. Now do you see what hard work it is For a man?

prakrit: पेम्मस्स विरोहिअसंधिअस्स पच्चक्खदिट्ठविलिअस्स,उअअस्स व ताविअसीअलस्स विरसो रसो होइ
english: Love Estranged and patched up again, Once its dissolution is plain to see, Will never taste right again Like water that has boiled then cooled

prakrit: वज्जवडनाइरिक्कं पइणो सोऊण सिंजिणीघोसं,पुसिआइ करिमरीए सरिवंदीणं पि अच्छीइं
english: Thinking she hears the twang of her husband's bow Above the crashing thunder, The captive wife tells the royal hostages To wipe away their tears.

prakrit: करिमरि अआलगज्जिरजलआसणिवडणपडिरवो एसो,पइणो धणुरव कंखिरि रोमंचं किं मुहा वहसि
english: It is only the echo of a thunderclap From an early rain cloud. I suppose you were hoping it might be the twang Of your husband's bow, For why else is the hair on your body bristling?

prakrit: सहइ सहइ त्ति तेण तहा रमिआ सुरअदुव्विअड्डेण,पव्वाअसिरीसाइ व जह से जाआइ अंगाइं
english: Because she put up with it all The clumsy youth went on making love to her So that her limbs now look like wilting acacia flowers.

prakrit: असरिसचित्ते दिअरे सुद्धमणा पिअअमे विसमसीले,ण कहइ कुडुंवविहडणभएण तणुआअए सोण्हा
english: She does not complain to her husband About his brother's advances Not because she herself has impure thoughts But because he is so touchy And she is afraid of causing a split in the family. Instead she pines away.

prakrit: चिंताणिअदइअसमागमम्मि कअमण्णुआइ भरिऊण,सुण्णं कलहा अंती सहीहि रुण्णा ण ओहसिआ
english: Imagining how it was when her lover was with her, The woman suddenly remembered how angry she had been And raged against thin air. Far from laughing, her friends wept for her.

prakrit: हिअअण्णुएहि समअं असमत्ताइं पि जह सुहावेंति,कज्जाइ मणे ण तहा इअरेहि समाणिआइं पि
english: Dealings with sympathetic people, Even if inconclusive, Are, I think, more pleasant Than dealings concluded With their opposite.

prakrit: दरफुडिअसिप्पिसंपुडणिलुक्कहालाहलग्गछेप्पणिहं,पिक्कंवट्ठिविणिग्गअकोमलम् अंवंकुरं उअह
english: Look! A tender shoot has sprouted from the stone of a ripe mango. It looks like an eel hiding in a half-opened oyster shell.

prakrit: उअह पडलंतरोइण्णणिअअतंतुद्धपाअपडिलग्गं,दुल्लक्खसुत्तगुत्थेक्कवउलकुसुमं व मक्कडअं
english: Look at that spider climbing down from the rafters Along a thread spun from between its feet: It looks like a mimosa flower strung on an invisible string.

prakrit: जइ होसि ण तस्स पिआ अणुदिअहं णीसहेहि अंगेहिं,णवसूअपीअपेओसमत्तपाडि व्व किं सुअसि
english: If you are not his lover, How come you sleep every day, Your limbs as weak As those of a newborn buffalo calf, Drunk on its mother's milk?

prakrit: हेमंतिआसु अइदीहरासु राईसु तं सि अविणिद्दा,चिरअरपउत्थवइए ण सुंदरं जं दिआ सुअसि
english: The winter nights are long, For months your husband's been away, So you must be sleeping well. How odd that you should fall asleep by day.

prakrit: जइ चिक्खिल्लभउप्पुअपअम् इणम् अलसाइ तुह पए दिण्णं,ता सुहअ कंडइज्जंतम् अंगम् एण्हिं किणो वहसि
english: If that woman, who stepped on your foot As she leapt away from the mud, Were so indifferent, Why, my dear, is your body now covered With gooseflesh?

prakrit: पत्तो छणो ण सोहइ अइप्पहाए व्व पुण्णिमाअंदो,अंतविरसो व्व कामो असंपआणो अ परिओसो
english: Once the festival starts its glamor is over, Like the full moon in broad daylight, Like sex which in the end loses its savor, Or like gratitude without a steady stream of gifts.

prakrit: पाणिग्गहणे च्चिअ पव्वईअ णाअं सहीहि सोहग्गं,पसुवइणा वासुइकंकणम्मि ओसारिए दूरं
english: Already at her wedding Paravati's friends knew she would be happy When Siva tossed aside The snake bracelet that frightened her.

prakrit: गिंहे दवग्गिमसिमइलिआइ दीसंति विंझसिहराइं,आससु पउत्थवइए ण होंति णवपाउसब्भाइं
english: What you see are the heights of the Vindhya Painted black by the forest fires of summer, Not fresh rain clouds. So do not worry about your husband's return.

prakrit: जेत्तिअमेत्तं तीरइ णिव्वोढुं देसु तेत्तिअं पणअं,ण जणो विणिअत्तपसाअदुक्खसहणक्खमो सव्वो
english: Give as much affection As you can muster. For not everyone can bear to suffer The withdrawal of kindness.

prakrit: वहुवल्लहस्स जा होइ वल्लहा कह वि पंच दिअहाइं,सा किं छट्ठं मग्गइ कत्तो मिट्ठं च वहुअं च
english: How can a woman Who for five whole days Has been the lover of such an attractive man Ask for one day more? One cannot feast on dainties.

prakrit: जं जं सो णिज्झाअइ अंगोआसं महं अणिमिसच्छो,पच्छाएमि अ तं तं इच्छामि अ तेण दीसंतं
english: Whatever part of my body he stares at I cover. At the same time I want him to see it.

prakrit: दढमण्णुदूमिआइ वि गहिओ दइअम्मि पेछह इमीए,ओसरइ वालुआमुट्ठिओ व्व माणो सुरसुरंतो
english: See how the woman's indignation at her husband Escapes with a soft sigh Like sand from a clenched fist.

prakrit: ण वि तह विएसवासो दोग्गच्चं मह जणेइ संतावं,आसंसिअत्थविमुहो जह पणइअणो णिअत्तंतो
english: More than his absence abroad Or my wretchedness here at home What pains me is my husband returning Without quite reaching his goal.

prakrit: भरिमो से गहिआहरधुअसीसपहोलिरालआउलिअं,वअणं परिमलतरलिअभमरालिपइण्णकमलं व
english: I will never forget how she shook her head When I tried to kiss her lips And her tresses flew in all directions. Her face looked like a lotus Surrounded by a swarm of bees Excited by its fragrance.

prakrit: हल्लफलण्हाणपसाहिआण छणवासरे सवत्तीण,अज्जाइ मज्जणाणाअरेण कहिअं व सोहग्गं
english: When her rivals take a freezing cold bath Before dressing for the festival, The youngest wife shows her privileged position By not bothering.

prakrit: ण्हाणहलिद्दाभरिअंतराइ जालाइ जालवलअस्स,सोहंति किलिंचिअकंटएण कं काहिसि कअत्थं
english: You won't make anyone happy By sitting here Removing with a bamboo needle The traces of turmeric soap From the meshes of your filigree bracelet.

prakrit: अद्दंसणेण पेम्मं अवेइ अइदंसणेण वि अवेइ,पिसुणजणकंपिएण वि अवेइ एमेअ वि अवेइ
english: Love vanishes Through not seeing enough of one another, Through seeing too much of one another, Through spiteful gossip, And sometimes just like that.

prakrit: पोट्टपडिएहि दुक्खं अच्छिज्जइ उण्णएहि होऊण,इअ चिंतंताण मणे थणाण कसणं मुहं जाअं
english: Thinking how wretched it is To be sagging over her stomach After having once been prominent —That's how her breasts must have got dark nipples.

prakrit: सो तुज्झ कए सुंदरि तह झीणो सुमहिलो हलिअउत्तो,जह से मच्छरिणीअ वि दोच्चं जाआइ पडिवण्णं
english: Lovely woman, The farmer has become so thin On your account That his good wife, though jealous, Now acts as go-between.

prakrit: दक्खिण्णेण वि एंतो सुहअ सुहावेसि अंह हिअआइं,णिक्कइअवेण जाणं गओ सि का णिव्वुई ताणं
english: Though you visit us only out of courtesy, You rejoice our heart. What delight you must give to those Whom you visit with genuine fondness.

prakrit: एक्कं पहरुग्घाअं हत्थं मुहमारुएण वीअंतो,सो वि हसंतीअ मए गहिओ वीएण कंठम्मि
english: While he was blowing on the hand That still stung from the slap I gave him, I could not help laughing And put my other hand around his neck.

prakrit: अवलंविअमाणपरंमुहीअ एंतस्स माणिनि पिअस्स,पुट्ठिपुलउग्गमो तुह कहेइ समुहट्ठिअं हिअअं
english: Proud lady, When he approached you You relentlessly turned away, But the gooseflesh on your back Shows that in your heart You are prepared to face him again.

prakrit: जानइ जाणावेउं अणुणअविद्दविअमाणपरिसेसं,पइरिक्कम्मि वि विणआवलंवणं स च्चिअ कुणंती
english: She knows how to give expression To what remains of the anger he tried to conciliate By acting with reserve Even when they are alone together.

prakrit: किं दाव कआ अहवा करेसि काहिसि अ सुहअ एत्ताहे,अवराहाण अलज्जिर साहसु कअरा खमिज्जंति
english: How dare you! And which offenses am I supposed to forgive, My darling: Those you have committed, Those you are committing, Or those you are about to commit?

prakrit: णूमंति जे पहुत्तं कुविअं दास व्व जे पसाअंति,ते च्चिअ महिलाण पिआ सेसा सामि च्चिअ वराआ
english: Women only like men Who mask their authority And grovel like slaves At their angry lovers' feet. All the rest make pitiful husbands.

prakrit: तइआ कअग्घ महुअर ण रमसि अण्णासु पुप्फजाईसु,वद्धफलभारगरुइं मालइम् एण्हिं परिच्चअसि
english: Ungrateful bee, Once you would not think Of enjoying yourself with other flowers But now that the jasmine is heavy with fruit You forsake her.

prakrit: अविअण्हपेच्छणिज्जेण तक्खणं मामि तेण दिट्ठेण,सिविणअपीएण व पाणिएण तण्ह च्चिअ ण फिट्टा
english: Aunt, A glimpse of that man, Whom one could never tire of staring at, Is like drinking water in a dream: It has not quenched my thirst.

prakrit: सो णाम संभरिज्जइ पब्भसिओ जो खणं पि हिअआहि,संभरिअव्वं च कअं गअं च पेम्मं णिरालंवं
english: Though he may for a moment Slip one's mind One still remembers a person. But love, Once it is but a memory, Vanishes For it is something immaterial.

prakrit: णासं व सा कवोलेअज्ज वितुह दंतमंडलं वाला,उब्भिण्णपुलअवइवेढपरिगअं रक्खइ वराई
english: The poor girl cherishes the teeth marks You have just left on her cheeks Like a pledge, Protecting them with a fence of gooseflesh.

prakrit: दिट्ठा चूआ अग्घाइआ सुरा दक्खिणाणिलो सहिओ,कज्जाइं चिअ गरुआइ मामि को वल्लहो कस्स
english: The mango puts out new shoots, The fragrance of liquor fills the air, An agreeable breeze is blowing from the south, But business must mean more to him And clearly he loves me no longer.

prakrit: रमिऊण पअं पि गओ जाहे उवऊहिउं पडिणिउत्तो,अहअं पउत्थवइअ व्व तक्खणं सो पवासि व्व
english: After making love, He took a step, then turned And took me in his arms again. That moment I felt what it was to be a wife whose husband is abroad And he what it was to be that woman's husband.

prakrit: अविअण्हपेच्छणिज्जं समसुहदुक्खं विइण्णसब्भावं,अण्णोण्णहिअअलग्गं पुण्णेहि जणो जणं लहइ
english: A man so handsome One cannot tire of looking at him, Who shares one's troubles as well as one's joys, Proves faithful and returns one's love —Such a man is only to be got through merit Accumulated over many lives.

prakrit: दुक्खं देंतो वि सुहं जणेइ जो जस्स वल्लहो होइ,दइअणहदूमिआण वि वड्ढइ थणआण रोमंचो
english: If one loves a man He gives pleasure even while causing pain. Though wounded by a lover's nails Breasts thrill with gooseflesh.

prakrit: धरिओ धरिओ विअलइ उवएसो पिअसहीहि दिज्जंतो,मअरद्धअवाणपहारजज्जरे तीअ हिअअम्मि
english: Try though she would to keep it, The advice given by her friends Escaped from her heart That was shattered by the arrow of the God of Love.

prakrit: वहुपुप्फभरोणामिअभूमीगअसाह सुणसु विण्णत्तिं,गोलाअडविअडकुडंग महुअ सणिअं गलिज्जासु
english: O sweetwood tree, Whose branches, bowed by the weight of blossom, Reach to the ground In the broad thickets on the bank of the Goda, Do me a favor And shed your leaves slowly.

prakrit: णिप्पच्छिमाइ असई दुक्खालोआइ महुअपुप्फाइं,चीए वंधुस्स व अट्ठिआइ रुअरी समुच्चिणइ
english: Weeping, The woman gathers the very last sweetwood flowers Now painful to behold, Like the bones of a relative On the funeral pyre.

prakrit: ओ हिअअ मडहसरिआजलरअहीरंतदीहदारु व्व,ठाणे ठाणे च्चिअ लग्गमाण केणा ऽवि डज्झिहिसि
english: Heart, After getting stuck here and there, Like a log Borne along by the current of a shallow stream, One day you will be fuel for someone.
